strings.(사라스바티가 눈을 감은 채로 깊은 생각에 잠겨 있다. 그러다 다가오는: (Sarasvati is deep in thought with her eyes closed. Sensing someone approach, she opens her eyes and looks ahead.)
strings.매번 여기까지 오시게 해서 죄송합니다. 격실을 함부로 나갈 수 없는 상태: I'm sorry to keep asking you to come all this way. I cannot leave the Isolation Room freely...
strings.괜찮아요, 사라스바티가 홀로그램으로 갑자기 나타난다는 건 분명 보통 일은: It's all right. If you're suddenly appearing by hologram, it must be something unusual.
Thank you for understanding. I'll get straight to the point.
I would like to ask for your help with a matter concerning the Hyperspace Network.
What? The Hyperspace Network...? I don't know anything about it...
strings.모험가님께서도 알고 계실 겁니다. 여러 세계와 기억을 가진 모험가님의 흔: You should already be aware of this: traces of you, with memories from various worlds, have been entering the network...
My authorization has allowed me to view and organize such data, but...
strings.(사라스바티가 손을 뻗는 순간, 격실 안의 모든 모니터가 검은색으로 가득: (The moment Sarasvati reaches out, every monitor in the Isolation Room turns black.)
strings.이 데이터만 이런 상태입니다. 제가 액세스 시도를 할 때마다 거부하고 있: Only this data behaves this way. It rejects every attempt I make to access it.
strings.물론, 이 데이터만 건드리지 않으면 아무런 문제도 없습니다. 시스템을 리: Of course, there are no problems as long as I leave it alone. I'll reboot the system, then continue.
strings.(사라스바티의 손이 바쁘게 움직인다. 잠시 후, 격실 안의 모니터가 원래: (Sarasvati's hands move rapidly. A moment later, the monitors in the Isolation Room return to normal.)
strings.액세스 권한을 나눠주시면 됩니다. 방법은 어렵지 않지요. 여기에 손을 올: Share your access privileges with me. It isn't difficult. Simply placing your hand here will be enough.
Thank you. I should be able to sort this out immediately.
strings.(사라스바티의 설명대로 %s의 손이 펼쳐진 홀로그램 창 위에 올라간다.): (Following Sarasvati's instructions, %s places a hand on the holographic window she has opened.)
strings.사라스바티? 왜 그렇게 놀라요?: Sarasvati? Why do you look so startled?
(At Sarasvati's gesture, the folders and documents within the hologram disappear.)
strings.제가 언젠가 새로운 데이터가 나타나면 확인해도 좋다는 말씀을 드렸을 겁니: I believe I once told you that you were welcome to examine any new data that appeared.
This data concerns you as well. However...
I would not recommend viewing it...
What could it possibly contain? I'll be all right.
strings.모험가님께서 열람만 한다고 해서 무슨 일이 일어나는 건 아닙니다. 하지만: Nothing will happen merely because you view it. But... even so...
strings.열람 권한이 제게 있는 데이터라면 언제 봐도 보게 된다는 거겠죠?: If I have permission to view the data, I'll end up seeing it sooner or later, won't I?
Yes, but it doesn't have to be now. Ah...
strings.(그때, 사라스바티의 앞으로 그동안 모습을 드러내지 않았던 존재의 홀로그: (Just then, holograms of beings who have not appeared for some time materialize before Sarasvati.)
Miss Sarasvati, %s. Forgive us for appearing so suddenly.
What's there to apologize for? We're just doing our job.
strings.잠시만 조용히 해주겠어?: Would you be quiet for a moment?
strings.두 분, 오랜만이에요,: It's been a while, both of you.
For you, %s, I suppose it has. Let's get to the point. That is...
strings.왜 내 대사를 뺏는 거지?: Why are you stealing my lines?
It doesn't matter who says it first.
strings.여전하시군요. 그런데 데이터를 바로 확인해야 하는 이유가 있나요?: You two haven't changed. But is there a reason I need to look at it right away?
strings.간단하게 설명해 드리죠. 이리스 양이 하는 일, 거기선 위대한 벽의 구축: Let me put it simply. It will make Iris's work easier. Building the Great Wall, I believe you call it there?
strings.저 데이터가 그 일을 방해하고 있다고 보면 돼. 시장 노점이 가끔 물건: Think of that data as getting in the way. You know how market stalls sometimes pile up so many boxes of goods that they block the street?
We're clearing away those boxes. If you examine the data now, the path will open right up.
strings.이런 걸로 형제의 우애가 망가졌다고 생각하는 건 아니겠지? 어쨌든, 서로: Surely you don't think something like this will ruin our brotherly bond? Anyway, you can think of the paths between our domains as being blocked.
Thank you for explaining. I'll examine it.
strings.감사합니다. 바로 해주실 줄 알았습니다. 용무가 끝났으니 저희는 이만 가: Thank you. I knew you would act at once. Our business is finished, so we'll be going now.
Huh? Leaving already? Honestly, he says his piece and goes. Can't be helped. I can't stay here on my own... Adios, then.
strings.(정신없이 떠들던 레코드와 쿼리 형제의 홀로그램이 사라지고, 사라스바티: (The holograms of the endlessly chattering brothers, Record and Query, disappear. Sarasvati stares at the spot where the Gate of Hell had been.)
strings.정말 괜찮으시겠습니까?: Will you really be all right?
I'll be fine. Please don't worry so much.
Then I'll prepare the data for viewing.
It's ready. Now, place your hand here.
strings.(사라스바티가 만들어낸 새로운 창 위로 모험가의 손이 올라온 순간, 격실: (The instant the adventurer places a hand on Sarasvati's new window, the Isolation Room slowly begins transforming into another place.)
strings.(무슨 내용일까? 사라스바티가 보는 걸 말릴 정도면….): (What could be in it? If Sarasvati tried to stop me from seeing it...)
strings.(아름다운 풍경 뒤로 보이는 기묘한 분위기가 그려지는 낯선 공간, 그 앞: (In an unfamiliar space, an uncanny atmosphere lies behind beautiful scenery. Someone speaks in a voice heavy with anger.)
strings.신도 아니고, 고작 인간의 언어로 나를 설득하려고 했나?: You are no god. Did you think mere human words could persuade me?
Why have this land and this world changed so, when all I have done is protect them for so long...? I... What have I been doing all this for...?
So this is my reward for protecting life...
strings.너는 분명 아니라고 할 것이다. 세레스 님의 뒤를 이어 별의 주인이 된: You will surely deny it. You belong to the one who succeeded Lady Seres as master of the star...
That does not make it forgivable.
I, and others like me, worked for life and for them. Like tools... Yes, I didn't mind being a tool.
strings.그런 취급을 받다 보니 정말 도구 같은 삶의 종말을 맞이했지만. 우습지도: After being treated that way, I truly did meet a tool's end. It's not even funny.
strings.그런데 그런 도구조차 제대로 다루지 못하는 주인이 무슨 의미가 있지?: But what use is a master who cannot even handle such tools properly?
strings.난 신을 원망하는 것이 아니다. 신의 뜻대로 행동하는 것뿐이지. 그래,: I do not resent the gods. I merely act according to their will. Yes, it makes no difference who you are.
strings.방해자라고 판단되면 기꺼이 죽여 이곳의 양분으로 쓰도록 하겠다. 내가 이: If I deem you an obstacle, I will gladly kill you and use you to nourish this place. That is my only reason for being here.
Though I do not know whether those who existed for the sake of life would rejoice...
strings.(목소리의 주인인 것 같은 자가 손을 뻗자 손가락 끝에서 빛이 모이기 시: (The apparent source of the voice reaches out. Light begins gathering at their fingertips, and someone's figure gradually emerges through its gaps.)
strings.(누군가의 그리움이 가득 담긴 이름이 불리는 순간, 빛이 거대한 창으로: (The moment a name filled with someone's longing is spoken, the light becomes an enormous spear and races toward the enemy.)
strings.(잠시 후, 공격을 피하지 못한 적이 관통당한 가슴을 붙잡고 제자리에 쓰: (A moment later, the enemy, unable to evade the attack, clutches their pierced chest and collapses.)
strings.(순간, 생기를 잃은 적의 눈동자와 마주친다.): (For an instant, my gaze meets the enemy's lifeless eyes.)
strings.내, 내가 죽은 거야…? 뭐, 뭐야?: I... I died...? Wh-what is this?
strings.(갑자기 생기를 잃은 눈이 깜박거린다. 손을 뻗어 쓰러진 존재를 확인하려: (Suddenly, the lifeless eyes blink. As I reach out to examine the fallen figure, the eyes rapidly swell until they fill the entire view.)
strings.(눈동자는 마치 늪지의 끈적거림처럼 %s에게 다가가 손부터 붙잡고 빨아들: (The eyes reach toward %s with the clinging pull of a swamp, seizing their hand and trying to suck them in.)
strings.(잠시 후, %s의 모습은 온데 간데 없이 눈동자에 삼켜져 보이지 않는다: (A moment later, %s is swallowed by the eyes and vanishes without a trace.)
strings.(앞에 보이는 풍경이 천천히 익숙한 격실의 모습으로 바뀐다. 익숙한 인물: (The scenery slowly changes back into the familiar Isolation Room. I recognize a familiar figure, and the dying person is gone.)
(Sarasvati catches %s as their legs give way and they begin to fall.)
Are you all right? If you're unwell, we should go to my sister Ishtar for treatment...
strings.(사라스바티의 앞으로 %s의 손이 올라온다.): (%s raises a hand in front of Sarasvati.)
I'm sorry. I didn't realize it would affect you so badly.
It's just that I've never experienced anything like this.
strings.정보를 조금 더 확인할 수 있을까요? 이것만으로는 제가 알 수 있는 게: Could I examine a little more of the information? I can't make sense of it from this alone...
strings.낮은 가능성이긴 하지만, 모험가님이 다른 세계의 자신을 인식했던 장소에: It's a slim possibility, but why not visit the place where you became aware of your other self from another world?
strings.(머릿속에서 그 장소가 떠오르는 것 같다.): (I think that place is coming to mind.)
strings.1. 언노운 아이들을 만났던 곳: 1. Where I met the Unknown children.
(No. I talked about many things with those children, but I don't think that was the time.)
strings.(다른 세계에서 온 여신 헬이 다른 사람과 나를 착각했지만, 내가 알아낸: (Hel, the goddess from another world, mistook me for someone else, but I didn't discover anything myself.)
strings.(분명 허무의 별에서 여러 이야기를 듣고 특별한 경험을 했지만, 그건 아: (I heard many things and had an extraordinary experience at the Star of the Void, but that isn't it.)
strings.(맞아. 나는 그곳에서 새로운 시공간의 나를 만났어….): (That's right. I met myself from another time and space there...)
strings.(그때 느꼈던 슬픈 감정이 다가와 가슴을 찌르는 것 같다.): (The sorrow I felt then returns, piercing my chest.)
The data in the spacetime network... What I saw, I mean...
strings.신이라 불리는 분들의 힘은 이곳에 닿지 않습니다. 그러니 보실 수 없을: The power of those called gods does not reach this place. So they would not be able to see it...
If their power truly reached here...
strings.(사라스바티가 하려던 말이 더 있는 것 같았지만 멈춘다.): (Sarasvati seems to have more to say, but stops herself.)
I'm sorry. I shouldn't have said that.
It's all right. If anything happens, I'll go and explain it myself.
strings.(…무슨 일이 일어날지는 모르겠지만, 그래도 가보는 게 좋겠지. 가지 않: (...I don't know what will happen, but I should still go. If I don't, I won't learn anything.)
Let's go. To the Drifting City...
strings.(현장에서 쓰이는 도구를 정비하고 있던 아니스가 근심 가득한 표정으로 하: (While maintaining tools used at the site, Anise looks up at the sky with a troubled expression.)
Sigh. I need to go see Narsha...
I need permission to return to the Guild Union.
strings.나르샤 양은 괜찮을 겁니다. 오해가 있었지만, 마법청 마법사들 덕분에 무: Miss Narsha will be all right. There was a misunderstanding, but I hear she returned safely thanks to the Magic Bureau's mages.
It's still my fault. She went because I recommended her.
strings.아니스 양, 자책하다 보면 허공해 끝까지 들어가게 됩니다. 그러니까 그만: Miss Anise, if you keep blaming yourself, you'll sink to the bottom of the Void Sea. Let's stop there.
strings.(뮐러가 단호하게 말하자 시무룩했던 아니스의 표정이 다시 돌아온다.): (At Muller's firm words, Anise's downcast expression returns to normal.)
Have the agents still not discovered the source of the explosions?
strings.건물 상태를 모조리 확인했지만, 전혀 알 수 없었대요. 조사를 마무리하는: They checked every building, but couldn't find anything. It happened while we were wrapping up the investigation, so it's a little troubling.
strings.이곳에 와서 성과랄 게 아무것도 없었으니 의회에서도 정리하고 싶어했을 겁: We had nothing to show for coming here. The council must have wanted to close the matter.
strings.이제 저도, 아니스 양도 글래스턴에서 할 일이 많을 겁니다. 이곳에 나름: Now both you and I will have much to do in Glaston. It feels as though we've been here quite a while, but I still don't understand this place.
strings.한 10년 된 거 같죠?: Feels like about ten years, doesn't it?
You seem to have cheered up enough to joke, Miss Anise. Hehe.
strings.안녕하세요, 아니스, 뮐러 경. 잘 지내셨죠?: Hello, Anise, Sir Muller. Have you been well?
strings.(여전히 반기는 눈치는 아니군…..): (He still doesn't seem pleased to see me...)
strings.정말 오랜만이에요. 그동안 잘 지내셨죠?: It really has been a while. Have you been well?
I heard you rescued travelers who'd lost their way at the Nereis Gateway.
strings.구조된 사람 중에 아델발트 가의 사람도 있었다. 무슨 돼지 인형이 된 것: One of those rescued belonged to the Adelwald family. They were spouting odd nonsense about feeling like they'd turned into a pig doll. Know anything about that?
Has something happened? Everyone looks busy.
We kept hearing enormous explosions, so we've been trying to find out what's happening.
strings.저번엔 이상한 구멍이 생기더니, 이번엔 알 수 없는 폭발음이라니…. 후우: First a strange hole appears, and now unexplained explosions... Sigh. I want to leave this place as soon as possible, but it won't let me.
Sir Muller, I'm sure it will be all right.
It had better be, Miss Anise. In this place, normality is what's strange.
strings.자, 신의 심부름 꾼께서 이곳엔 무슨 일로 오셨지?: Now, what brings the goddess's errand runner here?
strings.(뮐러의 질문과 함께 아니스의 반짝거리는 눈동자가 %s에게로 향한다.): (As Muller asks his question, Anise turns her sparkling eyes toward %s.)
Well... There's something I'm looking for.
strings.그러면 그거 말고 다른 것에 대해 하나만 묻지. 제국과 관련된 일인가?: Then let me ask just one other thing. Does it concern the Empire?
Good. Very well. Find it quickly and be on your way.
strings.바쁘실 텐데, 어서 가보세요. 언제 한 번 언니하고 나르샤와 같이 만나요: You must be busy, so please go ahead. Let's meet with my sister and Narsha sometime, adventurer.
Yes. Take care, Anise. You too, Sir Muller...
strings.(허락 아닌 허락을 받은 셈이 됐네. 그러면 가볼까.): (I suppose that was permission of a sort. Shall I go?)
strings.(표류도시를 헤매던 중, 갑자기 알 수 없는 울림이 느껴진다.): (While wandering the Drifting City, I suddenly feel an inexplicable rumbling.)
strings.땅이 흔들리는 건가? 빨리 지나가야겠어. 어?: Is the ground shaking? I'd better hurry through. Huh?
strings.(서둘러 다른 곳으로 가려고 했지만, 발이 움직이지 않는다. 다시 움직여: (I try to hurry elsewhere, but my feet will not move. I try again, with the same result.)
strings.(누군가 붙잡고 있는 것처럼 움직이지 못하고 있던 %s의 앞에 알 수 없: (An unknown shadow appears in an oval shape before %s, who is unable to move, as though someone is holding them in place.)
strings.로젠가르텐에서도, 바니타스에서도 봤었던…. 아, 안돼!!: I saw it in Rosengarten... and Vanitas... N-no!!
strings.(그림자가 점점 커지면서 덮칠 것처럼 다가오기 시작한다. 당황한 나머지: (The shadow grows, approaching as though ready to pounce. I fall backward in panic, and my terror of it grows.)
strings.(그때, 바닥에서 초록색 빛이 솟아올라 거대한 벽이 된다. 벽은 금방이라: (Then green light rises from the ground, forming a huge wall. It holds back the shadow that seems ready to devour everything.)
Huh? I can move my feet? L-let's get out of here.
strings.(어느샌가 검은 그림자가 커져 초록색 빛으로 만들어진 벽을 제외하곤 %s: (Before long, the black shadow has grown to surround %s on all sides except for the wall of green light.)
strings.(그 순간, 벽에서 뭔가 불쑥 튀어나온다.): (At that moment, something suddenly protrudes from the wall.)
strings.(누구의 것인지 알 수 없는 여성의 손이 다가오라는 것 같은 손짓을 한다: (An unknown woman's hand beckons me closer.)
Take my hand, unless you want to be swallowed up and disappear...
strings.(이 목소리는…? 분명, 들어본 적 있는데….): (This voice...? I've definitely heard it before...)
strings.(갑자기 여성의 손이 목소리의 주인을 떠올리고 있던 %s의 손을 붙잡는다: (While %s tries to place the voice, the woman's hand suddenly seizes theirs.)
strings.이번에는 날 믿어. 다음엔 믿지 않아도 되지만. … 지금은 널 믿는 신에: Trust me this time. You don't have to next time. ...For now, I'll send you to the goddess who believes in you. Trust me.
strings.(손의 주인이 강한 힘으로 %s의 손을 잡아당긴다.): (The hand's owner pulls %s forcefully toward her.)
strings.(날 삼키려고 했던 그림자는 조금씩 멀어지고 있는데…, 나는 졸려…. 날: (The shadow that tried to swallow me is slowly receding... But I'm sleepy... This hand holding mine...)
S-so suddenly. How did you get here...?
This place... I was holding a hand...
strings.(이리스가 놀란 눈으로 다가와 %s의 상태를 살핀다.): (Iris approaches with wide eyes and checks %s's condition.)
strings.무슨 일이 있었던 거예요? 괜찮아요?: What happened? Are you all right?
Why... Why did I suddenly come here...? I was...
It's all right. Just stay calm...
strings.(머뭇거리지 말고 전부 이리스에게 이야기하자….): (I should tell Iris everything without hesitating...)
strings.(이리스에게 사라스바티를 찾아가 이상한 내용의 데이터를 확인하고, 표류도: (I tell Iris everything: visiting Sarasvati, examining the strange data, and going to the Drifting City.)
strings.나도 그렇게 믿고 있어. 내가 모르는 다른 시공간의 나를 인식해도 달라지: I believe that too. Becoming aware of some other me from an unknown time and space doesn't change anything.
Thanks to you, I've found more work I need to do. I'll try a little harder.
I wasn't trying to give you more work, Iris...
...I've realized that the places I couldn't perceive were the Drifting City and Asgard. There should be no reason I can't perceive somewhere you've set foot, %s...
Asgard is a domain separate from Etoile, after all. And the Drifting City...
strings.여러 개의 시간이 맞닿은 장소. 하나의 시공간으로 정의하기엔 너무나 복잡: It's a place where many different times meet. Far too complex to define as a single spacetime.
strings.여기 있는 %s, 다른 세계 혹은 다른 시공간의 %s의 기억이 맞닿은 곳: A place where the memories of the %s here meet those of %s from another world, or another time and space...
For now, there's no way for me to intervene. Perhaps someday.
strings.그러면 날 구해준 사람은 대체 누굴까?: Then who could have saved me?
I don't know yet, but I have an idea... I'll tell you when I'm certain.
Yes, thank you. I'll tell you right away if I find out too.
There's something I need to tell you.
If you stand before the goddess statue at the Eidos Gateway, you'll be able to come here.
Really? That's wonderful. I'll come see you whenever I can.
strings.네, 그러세요. 그리고 사이암이 밖으로 나오게 됐어요. 지금은 여기 계시: Yes, please do. And Siam is able to come outside now. He isn't here at the moment, but he'll spend some time here preparing to return.
I'm glad he's able to come out... But when you say return...
strings.맞아요. 원래 다른 세계에서 오신 분을 계속해서 이곳에서 둘 수는 없으니: Yes. He originally came from another world. We can't keep him here forever...
strings.(사이암도 돌아가길 원하는 걸까? 이리스가 저렇게 말한다면 뭐….): (Does Siam want to go back too? If that's what Iris says, then...)
strings.이야기할 게 하나 더 있어요. 나르샤의 곁에 잠시만 있어주시겠어요?: There's one more thing. Would you stay by Narsha's side for a little while?
strings.오래 전부터 나르샤를 바라보는 눈이 있어요. 그 눈의 주인이 누군지 알: Eyes have been watching her for a long time. I don't know who they belong to, but the power in that gaze is growing stronger.
strings.고마워요. 저도 그게 누군지 알아볼게요. 미안해요. 아직 알 수 있는 게: Thank you. I'll try to find out who it is too. I'm sorry there's still so much I can't know...
It's all right. You have me, Iris.
Then I'll go straight to Narsha.
But how do I get out? Ahaha...
Walk slowly backward, and you'll reach the Eidos Gateway.
All right. See you next time, Iris...
(Once the adventurer disappears, the color drains from Iris's smiling face. She sinks to the floor.)
strings.(마침 신탁의 방으로 들어온 사이암이 서둘러 달려온다. 일으켜 세우려 하: (Siam, who has just entered the Oracle Chamber, hurries over. He tries to help Iris up, but she waves a hand to show she is all right.)
I'm all right. Don't worry too much. I have to hold on so everyone else can be safe.
I'd like to tell you it's all right to rest sometimes, but...
I'm sorry I can be of no help...
strings.아니에요, 사이암. 사이암은 그때도 그랬지만, 언제나 위로가 돼요. 그러: That's not true, Siam. Just as you did back then, you always comfort me. So please focus on what lies ahead for you.
strings.(이리스가 환한 미소를 지으며 사이암을 바라본다.): (Iris looks at Siam with a bright smile.)
strings.이건 세레스 님의 힘을 받은 제가 해야만 하는 일. 너무 걱정하지 마세요: Having received Lady Seres's power, this is something I must do. Please don't worry so much.
I will never let the rainbow and the moon be consumed...
strings.(나르샤가 귀를 쫑긋 세우고, 한 손을 턱에 대고 깊은 생각에 빠져 있다: (Narsha's ears stand alert as she rests her chin on one hand, deep in thought. Madori, the magic golem perched on her shoulder, copies her pose.)
Narsha? What's on your mind? Madori looks deep in thought too...
strings.(나르샤가 시선을 피하는 걸 보면 분명 무슨 일이 있었던 것 같은데….): (She's avoiding my eyes. Something must have happened...)
strings.마도리요? 그렇죠? 언제나 함께하고, 여러 고비를 겪었더니 전보다 더 교: Madori? Doesn't he? We've always been together, and after getting through so many difficulties, I feel we understand each other better.
He's both a friend and family to me.
Ahaha, it's just a figure of speech. Nothing at all, adventurer.
I went to the Nereis Gateway on some business recently.
strings.네레이스 관문이요? 아, 맞다. 최근에 거기 계신 분들을 도와주셨다고 총: The Nereis Gateway? Oh, right. The president told me you helped the people there recently.
Yes. Things were a little complicated.
I went there not long ago too, and nearly ended up somewhere else...
strings.죄송해요. 제가 말씀드리지 않으려고 한 건 아닌데…. 걱정 끼쳐드리고 싶: I'm sorry. I wasn't trying to keep it from you... I just didn't want to worry you, so I couldn't tell you.
strings.그러면 어떻게 된 건지 말씀드릴게요. 제가 한동안 마법청에 가지 않으려고: Then I'll explain what happened. I'd decided to stay away from the Magic Bureau for a while.
But Anise and Ambrosia were thinking of me and sent me an invitation.
strings.마법청 주관으로 열리는 마법 세미나에요. 이번 주제는 정령과 생명이라고: It was for a magic seminar organized by the Magic Bureau. The topic was spirits and life. It was being held at the Sage's Tower, rather than the Magic Bureau's auditorium.
strings.현자의 탑은 언젠가 한번 가보고 싶기도 했고, 제가 못 갈 곳도 아니라: I'd always wanted to visit it, and I didn't think it was anywhere I couldn't go. So I told the president and went alone.
Of course, the president was worried and sent Raclette after me separately.
strings.네레이스 관문에서 게이트를 타고 그쪽 지역으로 가야 하는데, 전혀 이름을: I was supposed to take a gate from the Nereis Gateway to that region, but I arrived somewhere whose name I didn't even know.
strings.(또 게이트에 이면의 효과가 생긴 건가?): (Did the Reverse Side affect the gate again?)
strings.마법청 소속의 마법사와 고고학자들이 모여있는 캠프였어요. 거긴 오르카리움: It was a camp of mages and archaeologists from the Magic Bureau, at a ruin called Orcarium.
strings.비공개 장소였는데, 마도골렘과 함께 있는 제가 나타나니까 다들 놀라더라고: The site wasn't open to the public. Everyone was startled when I appeared with a magic golem.
I suppose anyone would be surprised to see a golem with a mind of its own, especially such a small one.
strings.마법사들은 특별한 연구를 많이 해서 웬만한 것들엔 잘 놀라지 않아요. 이: Mages conduct so much extraordinary research that very little surprises them. Some already knew about magic golems. But the reason they were startled was that I...
I'm not an ordinary human. I'm a girl who looks like this.
strings.게다가 특별한 마도골렘의 주인이 된 걸 탐탁지 않게 생각하는…, 그런 눈: And their eyes said they didn't approve of someone like me owning such a special magic golem...
That's why I hadn't wanted to leave Esnil...
strings.그런 분위기를 읽으셨는지, 친절하신 마법사 한 분이 게이트 있는 곳을 알: Perhaps sensing the mood, one kind mage told me where the gate was. He said he would explain things to the others...
strings.그런데, 뭔가 이상했어요. 게이트의 일부가 파괴된 거예요. 그 게이트는: But something was wrong. Part of the gate had been destroyed. It was a separate gate the Magic Bureau had built to reach the capital and other places...
strings.갑자기 캠프가 시끄러워져서 가보니…. 저와 비슷한 귀와 손을 가진 남자애: Then a commotion broke out at the camp. When I went to look... a boy with ears and hands like mine was destroying it.
strings.게다가 마도리보다 훨씬 큰 마도골렘을 가지고 있었어요. 그 골렘으로 캠프: He had a magic golem much larger than Madori. And he wasn't just using it to wreck the camp...
strings.마법사 몇 명을 알아보고 마도골렘에게 지시해 붙잡았어요. 그리고 멀리 보: He recognized a few of the mages and ordered his golem to seize them. Then it climbed to a distant cliff and dropped them.
strings.충격적이었어요. 골렘으로 그런 일을 한다는 자체가…. 순식간에 일어난 일: It was horrifying. To use a golem for something like that... It all happened so quickly that I couldn't stop it...
Our eyes met for an instant. He looked so lonely. And...
strings.(나르샤가 진정이 되지 않는지 마도리를 붙잡고 심호흡한다.): (Still unable to calm herself, Narsha holds Madori and takes a deep breath.)
strings.나르샤는 괜찮을 거야. %s 씨, 나머지 이야기는 나랑 해. 나르샤는 좀: Narsha will be all right. %s, you can hear the rest from me. Let her rest a little.
It's all right, Narsha. Get some rest. I'll talk to Dayna.
Is something troubling you? You were so deep in thought earlier that you didn't notice me arrive...
My identity, being different from everyone else. And my future with Madori.
strings.이것저것 하고 있지만, 아직도 잘 모르겠어요. 그래도 하다 보면 뭐라도: I've been trying different things, but I still don't know. Still, if I keep trying, I'll learn something eventually, won't I?
strings.(나르샤가 살짝 쓸쓸한 표정을 짓다가 마도골렘 마도리를 쓰다듬는다.): (A faintly lonely look crosses Narsha's face before she strokes Madori.)
I think I've learned a little more thanks to your help, adventurer. Thank you.
It was nothing. If there's anything I can do to help, I will.
strings.(이번엔 괜찮은 대화였지만, 이 주제도 아닌 것 같네….): (That was a good conversation, but I don't think it's the right subject either...)
strings.나르샤가 쉬는 동안 내가 나머지 이야기를 이어서 할까 해, 괜찮지?: I'll tell you the rest while Narsha rests. Is that all right?
strings.마법청의 자료를 입수해서 알아보니 마도골렘을 다루는 소년을 '노네임'이라: I obtained some Magic Bureau documents and found that they call the boy who controls the magic golem 'No Name.'
strings.이름을 따로 붙이지 않았는지 노네임이라 부르기 시작하더니 굳어진 것 같아: It seems they started calling him that because he had no other name for them to use, and it stuck.
strings.나르샤와 비슷한 능력에다 같은 귀와 손을 가지고 있어. 어째서 그곳에 나: He has abilities similar to Narsha's, as well as the same ears and hands. I don't know why he appeared there, but something important must be happening.
Still, the fact remains that the boy killed those mages...
strings.나르샤는 소년과 모습이 비슷하고 마도골렘을 가지고 있다는 이유만으로 공범: Simply because she resembled him and had a magic golem, Narsha was nearly framed as an accomplice... no, as the sole culprit. Fortunately, she managed to get out of it.
strings.마법사들이 마법청의 마도골렘 관련 일로 도움을 준 나르샤를 좋게 봐줘서: At least some of the mages thought well of her because she'd helped with the Magic Bureau's golem work.
Fortunately... I can't believe I'm saying that. What a thing to say about Narsha.
strings.모습이 다르다는 이유만으로 붙잡혔는데, 나르샤는 두려워하면서도 죽을지도: She was detained just for looking different. And even though she was frightened, she was accepting the possibility that she might die.
strings.제국 사람들이 보기에 자기는 '인간'이 아닌 것처럼 보이니까. 그런 수모: Because to the Empire's people, she doesn't look 'human.' To think she's enduring that humiliation...
It's maddening... Is this really all the Empire amounts to...?
strings.(데이나가 분개한 감정을 이기지 못하고 들고 있던 지팡이를 바닥에 내리친: (Unable to contain her anger, Dayna strikes the ground with her staff.)
I wish Narsha would rest, but she's looking for a way to return.
She seems to want to meet No Name and talk to him.
She wants to go back there? It'll be dangerous...
For better or worse, every route there has disappeared for now.
Even the teleportation magic of mages serving the Magic Bureau and the council's nobles has been blocked.
strings.그건 노네임의 힘이 아냐. 마도골렘의 힘도 아니고…. 갈렛과 라클렛을 데: That isn't No Name's power. Nor is it the golem's... I've been trying to get there with Galette and Raclette, but nothing works.
I wish there were another route...
strings.여신님께서 가보라고 한 거야?: Did the goddess tell you to go?
strings.네, 맞아요. 나르샤를 보는 눈이 있는데, 그게 누군지 모르겠다고 저에게: Yes. She said someone was watching Narsha, but she didn't know who. She asked me to help.
strings.나르샤를 보는 눈이라…. 알겠어. 그러면 %s의 생각대로 움직여줘. 우리: Eyes watching Narsha... All right. Then act as you think best, %s. We'll do everything we can on our side.
Then I'll get ready and go. Oh, Dayna...
strings.노네임이라는 소년을 찾는 일이요. 혹시 다른 일 때문도 있는 건가요?: About looking for the boy called No Name. Is there another reason for it too?
Yes. It's personal, and it concerns the Empire as well.
strings.10년 전, 바르바토스가 마녀와 손잡고 시이나를 데려가려고 했어. 그리고: Ten years ago, Barbatos joined forces with a witch and tried to take Shiina away. The Magic Bureau was involved too.
Ten years, and we're no closer...
Sigh. Enough of the long story. I should go now. I'll be off first.
strings.(데이나가 미소를 지으며 등을 돌린다. 언제 기다리고 있었는지 라클렛과: (Dayna smiles and turns away. Raclette and Jelic, who have apparently been waiting, follow her.)
Dayna seems a little hurried today...
strings.(일단 정보를 모아야 할 것 같은데, 누구에게 가보지….): (I should gather information first. Who should I visit...?)
strings.(마도골렘…. 아, 나르샤의 마도골렘 마도리를 손대려고 했던….): (Magic golems... Ah, the one who tried to tamper with Narsha's Madori...)
strings.(탈로스가 %s의 모습을 보이더니 피식 웃는다.): (Talos lets out a faint, mocking laugh at the sight of %s.)
I came because there's something I want to ask. I think it might interest you, Talos...
You haven't even brought anything this time. That's disappointing...
I'll hear you out and decide.
Narsha's magic golem, the one you were interested in...
strings.(마도골렘이라고 말하자마자 심드렁하던 탈로스의 눈빛이 바뀐다.): (The instant magic golems are mentioned, Talos's indifferent gaze changes.)
I thought you'd be interested. What happened was...
strings.(탈로스에게 나르샤가 겪었던 일의 일부를 이야기한다.): (I tell Talos part of what happened to Narsha.)
strings.(이야기를 듣고 있던 탈로스의 얼굴이 조금씩 굳어진다.): (As he listens, Talos's expression gradually hardens.)
strings.그런 마도골렘이 또 있었군. 마법청에는 그런 게 얼마나 더 있는 거지?: So there was another golem like that. How many more does the Magic Bureau have? Things that should have ceased to exist are still around...
That girl Narsha has done well to avoid being captured...
strings.후우…, 골치 아프군. 너란 인간은 이런 일 전문인 건가? 어차피 신들과: Sigh... What a headache. Are you some kind of specialist in these problems? Mixed up with the gods as you are, I suppose the outcome is obvious.
strings.마도골렘은 보통 마력을 부여하면 움직이지. 제국에 있는 건 대부분 그런: Magic golems normally move when supplied with magical power. Most in the Empire are that kind. They keep addressing the shortcomings and producing new models.
But what about Narsha's golem? It's a little different, isn't it...?
It seems you picked up a tail on your way here.
I didn't bring anything with me.
strings.유격병 초소가 있는 뱡향이 시끄럽군. 바보 유격병놈이 감히 꼬맹이를 붙잡: It's noisy over by the ranger outpost. That idiot ranger dares to detain the little girl...
strings.(탈로스가 인상을 쓰며 크노소스 가도 입구 초소 쪽을 바라본다. 그러더니: (Talos frowns toward the outpost at the entrance to Knossos Road, then begins walking that way.)
Talos? By little girl, you mean...
strings.헛소리 하지 마라!! 동물 귀, 짐승의 손, 게다가 마도골렘까지 있는 수: Stop spouting nonsense!! Animal ears, beast's hands, and a magic golem. You're a beastfolk, just like the one on this wanted poster!
But the wanted person is a boy.
strings.그런 건 난 몰라. 어차피 수인이 하는 짓이 다 그렇지. 야만적이고 인간: I don't care about that. Beastfolk are all the same. Savages who want to kill humans...
strings.그런데 방금 너 뭐라고 했지? '사람'이라고?: Wait, what did you just call yourself? A 'person'?
strings.무슨 수작을 꾸미는 건지 모르겠지만, 순순히 붙잡히는 게 좋을 거다. 죽: I don't know what you're scheming, but you'd better come quietly. I don't want to kill you.
strings.(하바티의 손짓에 따라 같이 있던 유격병들이 나르샤를 향해 달려간다.): (At Havarti's gesture, the rangers with him rush toward Narsha.)
I have an imperial identification card. This proves who I am...
strings.(하바티가 나르샤의 카드를 빼앗아 산산조각낸다.): (Havarti snatches Narsha's card and tears it to pieces.)
A beastfolk dares invoke the imperial family? You could have forged a card like that anywhere. Seize this beastfolk, now!
strings.(유격병이 나르샤의 팔을 붙잡으려고 하는 순간, 어깨에 있던 마도골렘 마: (As a ranger reaches for Narsha's arm, the magic golem Madori, perched on her shoulder, shoves him back.)
strings.강제로라도 제압…, 어?: Subdue her by force if you... Huh?
strings.(하바티의 말이 끝나기가 무섭게 나르샤의 옆에 있던 유격병들이 그대로 피: (Before Havarti can finish, the rangers beside Narsha collapse, bleeding.)
What is this, Talos? How dare a beastfolk meddle in imperial affairs!
strings.마치 뭔가 되는 것처럼 이야기하는군. 제국의 개 주제에. 한 번만 더 수: You speak as though you're someone important. You're just the Empire's dog. Call me beastfolk one more time, and I'll swallow you whole. Or should I send you flying into the Void Sea?
strings.…이라고 할 줄 알았냐? 유격소총은 폼인 줄 알았는데, 아니었군. 제대로: ...Did you think I'd say that? I thought that ranger rifle was just for show. Apparently not. If you really want to kill someone, aim for the head. This head.
strings.(탈로스가 어깨에 박힌 총알을 아무렇지도 않게 빼내고는 유격병 하바티의: (Talos casually pulls the bullet from his shoulder, then points at Ranger Havarti's head.)
You're alive after that shot? Wh-what are you? Gah, gaaaah...
strings.(하바티가 탈로스의 손에 목을 붙잡혀 괴로움을 호소한다. 하지만, 탈로스: (Havarti cries out in pain as Talos grips him by the throat. Talos merely smiles, unconcerned.)
strings.내가 뭐라고 했지? 허공해로 날려버리겠다고 한 게 농담처럼 들렸나 봐?: What did I tell you? Did you think I was joking about throwing you into the Void Sea?
strings.(그제야 탈로스가 %s의 목소리가 들려오는 곳을 바라본다. 흔들리고 있는: (Only then does Talos look toward %s's voice. Meeting Narsha's trembling gaze, he lets out a sigh.)
All right, all right. I was going to stop and let him go.
strings.(탈로스가 손을 놓자 하바티가 그대로 땅에 떨어진다.): (Talos releases his grip, and Havarti drops to the ground.)
Havarti, I can vouch for Narsha's identity. Please let her go.
strings.모험가님은 왜 이 수인 편에 계시는 겁니까?: Why are you siding with this beastfolk, adventurer?
strings.어쩔 수 없지. 토끼 마녀가 했던 걸 써먹어볼까?: Can't be helped. Shall I try that trick the rabbit witch used?
I'm not going to kill him. Don't worry. I'll just erase a few memories...
A mere beastfolk from Creed dares treat an imperial citizen...
strings.이놈 근성은 알아줘야겠네. 후: I have to give him credit for persistence. Heh.
strings.마무리를 하지 않으면 너도나도 모두 귀찮은 일에 휘말릴 거야. 제국의 나: Unless I finish this, we'll all be dragged into trouble. The Empire's villains will seize the opportunity and come after us.
strings.꼬맹이는 어때? 내 맘대로 하고 싶은데?: What do you think, little one? I'd like to do this my way.
You'll do it even if I say no.
strings.맞아, 크노소스에선 내 맘대로 해도 되는걸. 그러면 다들 동의하는 걸로: Correct. I can do as I please in Knossos. Then I'll take it that everyone agrees.
What are you doing? You people! What on earth are you...?
(With a nasty smile, Talos taps Ranger Havarti's shoulder with his staff.)
strings.(하바티가 머리를 붙잡고 비명을 지르기 시작한다. 크노소스에 있던 새들이: (Havarti clutches his head and begins screaming. Birds in Knossos take to the sky, startled by the sound. It happens over and over...)
strings.(마지막엔 유격병 하바티가 피를 토하고 그대로 쓰러진다. 나르샤가 서둘러: (Finally, Ranger Havarti coughs up blood and collapses. Narsha hurries over to check on him.)
He's not dead. He's only unconscious...
strings.이 정도 해야 우리에 대한 기억을 모두 잃어버리지. 안 그래?: It takes this much to make him forget everything about us. Doesn't it?
strings.꼬맹아. 크노소스의 관리자로서 환영한다. 바로 수인왕을 만나러 가. 원래: Little one. As the administrator of Knossos, I welcome you. Go straight to the Beastfolk King. Normally, only %s may enter, but you can go in together.
And that's my work here finished.
So this is how you help people.
strings.어딜 가든 가기만 하면 되는 거 아냐? 어서 가봐. 수인왕께서 또 화나면: As long as you get where you're going, what does it matter? Off you go. If the Beastfolk King gets angry again, all of Knossos will shake.
All right, Talos. Thank you. Though... should I be thanking you for this...?
strings.네 마력이 강해지면 마도골렘을 더 잘 제어할 수 있을 거야. 네 뜻도 마: As your magical power grows stronger, you'll be able to control your golem better. It will understand your wishes more clearly too.
strings.(저 사람이 나타났을 때, 내 손에서 벗어나려던 마도리의 움직임이 멈췄어: (When he appeared, Madori stopped trying to break free of my hands...)
strings.(나르샤도 느낀 걸까? 탈로스 때문에 마도리가 멈춘걸….): (Did Narsha notice too? That Madori stopped because of Talos...)
strings.(모험가와 나르샤가 떠난 걸 확인한 탈로스가 초소를 둘러보다 수상한 물건: (Once the adventurer and Narsha have left, Talos looks around the outpost and finds a suspicious object.)
strings.이건 마족의 문장…. 평소보다 유격병들이 흥분을 한 게 역시 이것 때문이: A demon crest... So this was why the rangers were more agitated than usual. The Archduke wouldn't do something like this. Then... Hmm?
strings.(탈로스가 다가오는 살기를 느끼고, 몸을 피한다. 아직 잠들지 못한 유격: (Sensing murderous intent approaching, Talos dodges. Ranger Havarti, who has not yet lost consciousness, struggles to load his rifle.)
strings.불쌍하군. 일어날 힘조차 없으면서 날 죽이려 하다니…. 다프네가 알려준: Pathetic. You can barely get up, yet you want to kill me... Does the method Daphne taught me not work on ordinary humans?
No choice, then. I'll have to swallow you.
strings.(그 말과 함께 탈로스의 등 뒤에서 거대한 그림자가 소용돌이처럼 일어난다: (As he speaks, a vast shadow swirls up behind Talos and engulfs Ranger Havarti.)
strings.(아크로의 관에 들어가자마자, 나르샤가 발걸음을 멈추고 뒤를 돌아본다.): (Just after entering Acro's Coffin, Narsha stops and looks back.)
strings.아무것도 아니에요. 그 아저씨가 있던 곳에서 이상한 소리가 들린 것 같아: Nothing. I thought I heard a strange sound from where that man was... Did you hear anything?
I felt something a little strange... But I didn't hear a sound.
Um, adventurer. There's something I'd like to ask.
strings.수인왕이라는 분은 어떤 분이세요?: What sort of person is the Beastfolk King?
I don't know him very well either, but I'll tell you briefly.
He was the ruler when the Silvaria Empire was in conflict with Creed, the beastfolk territory.
strings.정확히 무슨 일인지 알 수 없지만, 그때 아크로의 관에 갇히고 수백년 동: I don't know exactly what happened, but he was imprisoned in Acro's Coffin then, and awoke after sleeping for hundreds of years.
strings.(크노소스에서 겪었던 일을 정리해서 나르샤 에게 간단하게 이야기한다.): (I briefly recount to Narsha what happened in Knossos.)
All that happened in Knossos...? I had no idea.
strings.그분을 만나서 이야기를 해봐요. 답을 얻을 수 있을 지도 모르니까. 나르: Meet him and talk to him. You may find some answers. Stay close and be careful, Narsha.
The way to the Beastfolk King is a little rough.
I was waiting for your visit.
You startled me with that sudden attack. Though it isn't the first time...
Forgive me. Your aura has changed so much that I mistook you for someone else. Ah, there is another I should welcome. Come, child of my people.
strings.(미노스가 대련하는 두 사람을 피해 멀리 숨어있던 나르샤를 부른다.): (Minos calls to Narsha, who had hidden some distance away to avoid their sparring.)
Yes, child. Hold out your hand.
strings.(나르샤가 손을 뻗자 어깨에 있던 마도리가 천천히 내려와 미노스에게로 향: (As Narsha reaches out, Madori slowly climbs down from her shoulder and moves toward Minos.)
strings.마도리가 왜 저분에게 가는 거지?: Why is Madori going to him?
strings.(미노스에게 다가가던 마도골렘이 몸을 돌려 나르샤를 바라본다.): (The magic golem approaching Minos turns to look at Narsha.)
strings.이 골렘의 이름이 마도리라 했느냐?: Did you say this golem's name is Madori?
strings.역시 네가 부르는 이름에 반응하는 걸 보니 골렘이 선택한 자답다. 그게: It responds to the name you call it. You truly are one chosen by a golem. That is proof you belong to our people.
Our... people... But I look a little different... My hands...
strings.그런 건 상관없다. 생명이 깃든 골렘의 주인으로 선택된 자는 우리 일족: That does not matter. Only our people are chosen as masters by golems with life within them. Golem, return to your master.
(At Minos's gesture, the magic golem Madori returns to Narsha's side.)
Memories from long ago returned to me, and for a moment I could not speak.
strings.%s, 네가 이 아이를 데려왔다면 필시 무슨 일이 있는 거겠지. 그 이야: %s, if you have brought this child here, something must have happened. Tell me about it.
strings.그리고 아이야. 네 이름은 무엇이지?: And you, child. What is your name?
One who will soar high... A fine meaning.
strings.미안하다, 나르샤. 내가 이곳에 갇히지 않았다면 넌 분명 지금보다 나은: Forgive me, Narsha. Had I not been imprisoned here, you would surely have led a better life...
Your words alone mean a great deal. I'm all right. I've been doing well.
strings.(나르샤가 웃고 있지만, 얼굴에 슬픔이 살짝 드리워져 있다.): (Narsha smiles, but a hint of sadness shadows her face.)
strings.(나르샤가 오르카리움에서 겪은 일을 하나도 빼놓지 않고 미노스에게 전한다: (Narsha tells Minos everything that happened in Orcarium, leaving nothing out.)
strings.골렘을 데리고 다니는 아이가 또 있나 보군. 그 아이가 오르카리움에 있는: So there is another child who travels with a golem. If that child is in Orcarium...
You have an idea what it might mean.
strings.보통의 골렘은 마력을 부여받아 움직이지. 흙에 기계가 섞여 지금의 형태가: Ordinary golems move when given magical power. Even those that now combine earth and machinery should be no different.
strings.제국이 침범하면서 우리 골렘을 가져가 연구하고 개량했지만, 아직도 해결하: When the Empire invaded, it took our golems to study and improve them. Yet there is something it has never managed to solve.
strings.자아를 가진 골렘…, 나르샤와 함께 하는 종류는 만들고 싶어서 만들어지는: A golem with a mind of its own... The kind that accompanies Narsha cannot simply be made at will.
strings.정령과 같은 결의 기운이 깃들여야 하고, 그걸 느낄 수 있는 우리만이: It must hold an energy akin to that of spirits. Only we, who can sense that energy, can set it in motion.
strings.(칼리 족과 크노소스의 사람들이 정령과 관계있다는 이야기인데….): (So the Kali tribe and the people of Knossos are connected to spirits...)
strings.그래서 그런 걸지도 모르겠군. 제국의 마법사들이 그곳을 파헤치고, 골렘을: Perhaps that explains it. The Empire's mages are digging through that place, and the child with the golem seems to be searching for something too...
strings.정령과 관계된 힘이겠죠?: A power connected to spirits, right?
Indeed. Orcarium is a place of light that awakens spirits.
strings.(미노스가 잠시 뭔가 생각하다가 들고 있던 지팡이를 땅에 꽂는다. 잠시: (Minos thinks for a moment, then drives his staff into the ground. Soon, Acro's Coffin and the rest of Knossos tremble slightly.)
strings.오르카리움으로 가는 길이 없다고 해서 내가 만들었다. 사람이 가면 그곳이: You said there was no path to Orcarium, so I made one. Where people walk, a path shall be...
strings.%s, 부탁이 있다. 이 아이를 도와서 오르카리움에 다녀와다오. 마침 여: %s, I have a request. Help this child and accompany her to Orcarium. The goddess has already asked you to aid her, after all.
strings.고맙습니다, 미노스 님. 그런데 저 뒤에 상자는 뭔가요?: Thank you, Lord Minos. But what's that box behind you?
Narsha, I have something for you. I found it in the ruined castle a few days ago.
strings.오래전 제레니스가 우정의 증표로 선물했는데, 지금 나와 파시파에에겐 필요: Xerenis gave it to us long ago as a token of friendship. Pasiphae and I have no need of it now, so I will give it to you. Here, take it.
strings.제레니스의 마력이 남겨진 보호 의상이다. 골렘을 다루는 아이에게 어울리도: It is protective clothing infused with Xerenis's magic. It was made to suit a child who commands a golem.
Xerenis said it would suit the child Pasiphae and I might one day have, once they had grown...
strings.…이런 귀한 걸 제게 주셔도 괜찮으시겠어요?: ...Are you sure you can give me something so precious?
Every object has an owner meant for it. This one seems to be yours.
strings.(나르샤가 미노스에게 옷 상자를 받자 말을 잇지 못한다.): (Narsha takes the box of clothes from Minos, at a loss for words.)
Thank you. I'll go change into it right away. I'd like to show you how it looks...
strings.…갈길이 멀텐데, 어서 떠나거라. 아, 일이 끝나면 이곳으로 오지 않아도: ...You have a long journey ahead. Go now. Oh, you need not return here when your task is done... I will hear news of you from %s later.
Yes, I'll tell you. Then, Lord Minos, we'll be off to Orcarium.
I never knew how welcome the words 'we'll be back' could sound...
strings.(발을 내딛자마자 주위의 풍경이 순식간에 바뀐다. 크노소스의 숲은 어느새: (The instant we step forward, the scenery changes. The forest of Knossos is gone, replaced by a mysterious place where river and sea meet.)
strings.미노스 님께서 열어주신 길로 왔더니 바로 오르카리움 캠프예요. 엘 아노르: The path Lord Minos opened brought us straight to Orcarium Camp. From the El Anor Mountains to the western continent in an instant...
It really is amazing. It looks like we can go back too...
The clothes Lord Minos gave me are so light. They fit perfectly. And they're so pretty.
They really suit you, Narsha. You have a whole new air about you. It's like you've awakened.
strings.각성? 좋은 거죠? 잘은 모르겠지만, 잘 어울린다고 하시니 기분이 좋네요: Awakened? That's good, right? I'm not sure what it means, but I'm happy you think they suit me. Hehe.
I think there's someone over by the camp.
strings.커다란 책을 들고 있는 마법사네. 어디서 봤더라?: A mage carrying a huge book. Where have I seen him before?
Don't be afraid. Follow me. I'll go first.
I thought I'd be moving up once I returned to headquarters. Instead, another assignment away...
strings.(페타가 캠프 앞으로 다가오는 두 사람을 보고 놀라 말을 잇지 못한다.): (Feta spots the two people approaching the camp and falls speechless in surprise.)
strings.뭐야? 여기는 마법청의 허가가 아니면 들어올 수 없을 텐데…. 잠깐, 저: What? No one should be able to enter without the Magic Bureau's permission... Wait, those two...
strings.모험가는 그렇다 쳐도, 골렘을 데리고 다니는 저 아이는 분명 범인이 아니: The adventurer is one thing, but they said the girl with the golem wasn't the culprit. What do they expect me to do on my own?
strings.대충 둘러대고 보내야겠다. 저 모험가는 골치 아픈 일만 잔뜩 가져올 테니: I'd better make something up and send them away. That adventurer will only bring a mountain of trouble...
strings.(페타가 어느 정도 마음의 준비를 했는지 영업용 스마일로 두 사람을 맞이: (Having more or less composed himself, Feta greets them with a professional smile.)
strings.그러게요, 게르다의 일은 뭐…. 그런데, 여기는 무슨 일로 오신 건가요?: It has. As for what happened in Gerda... Well. What brings you here? And that girl...
Hello, mage. We've come on some business.
Hmm. Where did you come from? Every route here has been blocked.
Well, I'm sure you found your own way.
strings.제국법에 의거, 현재 이곳은 마법청과 관련된 인물이 아니면 지나가실 수: Under imperial law, anyone unaffiliated with the Magic Bureau is currently forbidden from passing through this area.
Please wait until the other Magic Bureau personnel arrive.
strings.불법 침입자에 대해선 신병을 구속하라는 지시가 내려졌어요. 사실 실력으로: I have orders to detain trespassers. Of course, as a mere mage, I could hardly face an adventurer whose abilities have made them a monster.
strings.말이 그렇다는 거죠. 여기까지 오셨으니 제가 납득할 수 있을 만한 걸 보: It's a figure of speech. Since you've come all this way, show me something that will convince me.
No. Food. Eating is the only way I can replenish my magic...
strings.(나르샤가 작은 주머니를 꺼내서 손을 넣는다. 그리고 쉴 새 없이 계속해: (Narsha takes out a small pouch and reaches inside. She begins pulling out cakes and bread, one after another without stopping.)
strings.젤릭이 고향 마을 방식으로 만든 음식 저장 주머니예요. 마력만 일정하게: Jelic made this food-storage pouch using a method from his home village. As long as I supply a steady amount of magic, it maintains a constant temperature. Apparently, it can hold a houseful of bread.
strings.오호…, 신기하네요. 젤릭이라는 분이 누구신지 모르지만, 이 물건 탐나네: Oh...? Fascinating. I don't know this Jelic, but I'd love to have that.
strings.안 돼요. 이건 제 거예요. 음식을 잔뜩 드릴 테니까 탐내지 마세요!: No. It's mine. I'll give you lots of food, so don't get any ideas!
I'm not especially fond of cake, but when you're hungry, you can't be picky.
strings.페타, 음식은 나중에 먹고 좀 도와줘요. 이게 뭔지는 알고 있겠죠? 좀: Feta, eat later and help us first. You know what this is, don't you? Please help.
strings.(품에서 꺼낸 황실인증 카드를 보여주자 페타가 놀란 표정을 짓는다.): (When I produce my imperial identification card, Feta looks surprised.)
Oh... I'm envious. An ordinary citizen could never obtain one of those...
strings.황실에서 인증하는 카드니 신분은 확실하고 기타 등등 혜택까지 받을 수 있: An identity guaranteed by the imperial family, with all sorts of extra privileges. How nice.
strings.제 입장에선 이 카드의 주인을 막을 필요도 이유도 없지만…. 다만, 사고: From my position, there's neither a need nor a reason to stop the owner of that card... But if anything happens, I know nothing about it.
Just make sure I don't suffer for it.
It's been a while since I've met someone so difficult.
Since you've given me cake to fill my stomach, I'll explain the situation here briefly.
strings.(페타가 말을 하려는 순간, 캠프 밖 오르카리움에서 무슨 일이 일어났는지: (Just as Feta is about to speak, a commotion rises from Orcarium outside the camp.)
The murderer is still rampaging around Orcarium, which is why it's so noisy outside.
strings.동물들이 이상한 움직임을 보일 뿐 아니라 처음 보는 악마와 마족들도 나타: The animals are behaving strangely. Unfamiliar devils and demons have appeared, along with suspicious spirits and golems.
strings.제가 식사하는 동안, 잠깐 도와주시겠어요? 제가 상대하고 싶지만, 마력이: Would you help out for a moment while I eat? I'd deal with them myself, but I'm out of magic...
strings.후우, 알았어요. 그러면 캠프까지 오지 못하게 할 테니까 돌아오면 반드시: Sigh. All right. I'll keep them from reaching the camp. But you must explain things when I return.
Adventurer, let's go together. I'll help too.
Wait here a moment, Narsha. It might be dangerous. I'll be back quickly.
All right. Oh, adventurer, just a moment...
strings.(나르샤가 까치발을 들고 조용히 귓속말을 전한다.): (Narsha stands on tiptoe and whispers quietly.)
strings.…저분 맘이 바뀔 수도 있으니 계속해서 먹이를 주고 있을게요. 그리고 여: ...He might change his mind, so I'll keep feeding him. I've also picked up a map of the area. Go ahead.
Oh... All right. Keep him well fed.
strings.(나르샤가 일 잘하는 건 알고 있었는데, 이렇게도 하는구나.): (I knew Narsha was capable, but I didn't know she worked like this too.)
strings.몽글몽글 길드의 케이크와 빵들…. 말만 들었지, 이렇게 먹을 수 있을 줄: Cakes and bread from the Mongle Mongle Guild... I'd only heard about them. I never thought I'd get to eat them like this.
strings.…정말 대단하세요. 그 많은 걸 어떻게 다 드실 수 있죠. 어쩌면 앞에: ...You really are something. How can you eat so much? Without even offering a bite to the person in front of you.
strings.마법사들이 마력에 집중할 때면 좀처럼 앞이 보이지 않아요. 제가 그런 거: When mages focus on their magic, they tend to lose sight of their surroundings. That's how I am.
You certainly have an answer for everything.
Do I? Hehe... Oh, the adventurer is back.
strings.네, 제가 평소보다 조금 더 먹은 것 빼고는 캠프는 별일 없어요. 감사합: Yes. Apart from me eating a little more than usual, nothing has happened at camp. Thank you.
Please tell us about the situation here, as you promised.
I don't have much information myself, so I'll keep it brief.
strings.살인범의 이름이 따로 없으니 윗분들이 부르는 것처럼 노네임이라고 부를게요: Since the murderer has no other name, I'll call him No Name, as my superiors do.
I'm sure you know this already, but No Name is the same kind of being as Narsha here...
strings.여기서 사건을 일으키고 오르카리움 안쪽으로 들어가 아직도 모습을 드러내지: After causing the incident here, he went deeper into Orcarium and hasn't shown himself since.
We have established that he moves around at regular intervals...
...The Magic Bureau has a sample of No Name's unique magical signature. I thought only Bureau mages had those registered, but his was there too.
So it wasn't a coincidence that he attacked the Magic Bureau's mages.
That's the work of our superiors. Low-ranking mages like me don't know much about it.
strings.노네임의 마력이 제가 가진 도구와 오랫동안 공명하지 않으면 거의 죽은 거: If No Name's magic stops resonating with my instrument for long enough, we can assume he's more or less dead. Then all I need to do is inform headquarters...
That's all I know. Even if I knew more, I couldn't disclose it for security reasons...
strings.그러면 제게도 노네임에 대한 걸 알려주세요. 모험가님도 뭔가 알고 계신게: Then tell me what you know about No Name. You must know something too, adventurer.
strings.저도, 나르샤도 뭔가를 알고 싶어서 여기 온 거에요. 노네임에 대한 정보: Narsha and I came here to find things out. We don't have information about No Name.
It doesn't have to be about No Name.
strings.모험가님께서는 이미 신급 존재들과 만나는 사이신데, 아는게 아무것도 없다: You already associate with godlike beings, adventurer. It wouldn't make sense for you to know nothing.
strings.마법청에서 이런저런 실험을 하고 있는 것도 다 알고 계시지 않나요?: Surely you know the Magic Bureau conducts all sorts of experiments?
strings.새로운 그릇에 음식을 담듯이 만들어진 육체에 새로운 영혼을 담죠. 지금: Like placing food in a new vessel, we place new souls in bodies we've created. The miniature golems here are made that way. If we then use the life force of spirits...
The explanation must sound complicated. These things are difficult for an ordinary person to understand...
strings.(잠깐, 내가 지금 뭘 들은 거지? 저게 진짜 마법청이 하는 일이야?): (Wait. What did I just hear? Is that really what the Magic Bureau does?)
strings.(모험가와 나르샤가 캠프 밖으로 나갈 준비를 하자 페타가 놀란 표정을 짓: (Feta looks surprised as the adventurer and Narsha prepare to leave the camp.)
strings.모험가님, 이대로 가시게요? 정말 이야기해 주실 건 없으신가요?: Adventurer, you're leaving just like that? Do you really have nothing to tell me?
Thank you, Feta. We'll be going now.
strings.그러면 어쩔 수 없죠. 제가 편의를 봐 드린 것도 있고, 도움을 받은 것: Then it can't be helped. I've done you a favor, and you've helped me too...
Farewell. Still, come back to camp if you need help.
Of course. Let's talk about golems sometime, if we get the chance.
strings.(그렇게 두 사람이 사라지고 캠프가 한적해지자 페타가 기대고 있던 커다란: (Once the two have left and the camp is quiet, Feta takes something from between the pages of the enormous spellbook he has been leaning against.)
strings.노네임이 움직이고 있는 것 같은데…. 가서 알려줄까? 아냐, 일단 쫓아: No Name seems to be moving... Should I tell them? No, I'll follow them first.
I didn't expect the mage to follow us...
We've shaken him off, so we should be fine. I hope he goes back to camp.
strings.(나르샤가 주위를 돌아보면서 귀를 쫑긋거린다. 어디선가 들려오는 소리에: (Narsha looks around with her ears pricked up, seemingly concentrating on a distant sound.)
strings.(뭐지? 나르샤는 내가 못 듣는 그런 걸 듣는 건가?): (What's going on? Is Narsha hearing something I can't?)
I keep hearing voices chattering somewhere.
strings.마도리도 인식하는 것 같아요. 우리가 지나간 길에 있던 정령을 바라보는: Madori seems to notice them too. He appears to be looking at the spirits along the path we came through...
Ah, Lord Minos said golems have an energy akin to that of spirits...
strings.여기가 오르카리움이 정령을 깨우는 빛의 장소라고 하셨죠?: He said Orcarium is a place of light that awakens spirits, didn't he?
Perhaps the voices I'm hearing belong to spirits.
strings.모험가님, 저 궁금한 게 있어요. 정령은 사람과 말이 통하나요?: Adventurer, I'm curious about something. Can spirits and people understand each other?
That question caught me off guard. I've always been able to talk to them.
strings.이리스와 함께 있던 조에도, 게르다의 이오 님과 함께 있던 나린도 그렇고: Zoe, who was with Iris, and Narin, who was with Lady Io in Gerda... I don't think I've had trouble talking with spirits who have lived among people for a long time.
Is it only spirits who've taken physical form before people...?
strings.마도리의 기운과 비슷한 형태의 힘이 느껴져요. 마도리보다 훨씬 강력하고: I sense a power similar in nature to Madori's aura. Much stronger and more stable than his. Which means...
Narsha, follow me. Let's proceed carefully.
strings.왜 없는 거지? 왜? 왜!: Why isn't it here? Why? Why?!
strings.(한적한 느낌이 드는 오르카리움의 구석진 곳, 그 중심에서 한 소년이: (In a quiet corner of Orcarium, a boy searches for something, the ears on top of his head twitching.)
I've searched over and over... It has to be here...
strings.(소년이 수상한 소리가 들려오는 방향으로 고개를 돌린다.): (The boy turns toward the strange sound.)
We met once, and now you're acting like we're friends...
strings.도망친 줄 알았는데, 다시 왔네? 겁먹지도 않고. 게다가 촌스러운 인간도: I thought you'd run away. But you're back? Not scared at all? And you've brought a tacky human along.
strings.(의상으로 잔뜩 멋을 낸 소년이 손을 들어 모험가를 가리킨다.): (The elaborately dressed boy raises a hand and points at the adventurer.)
Ahaha. That's the first time anyone's called me tacky... No Name.
strings.(소년이 노네임이라는 이름을 듣자마자 피식 웃는다.): (The boy lets out a faint laugh the instant he hears the name No Name.)
strings.내 이름은 아니지만, 마음대로 불러. 어차피 난 그런 존재니까. 제국: It isn't my name, but call me whatever you want. That's all I am, anyway. Something the Empire's humans don't think needs a name...
Sigh. Talking while looking at something so tacky is exhausting.
strings.어떻게 오르카리움으로 들어왔어? 내가 이곳으로 오는 통로를 모두 막아놓았: How did you enter Orcarium? I blocked every passage here.
strings.커다란 마법서를 들고 있는 마법사는 어떻게든 오긴 했어도 방해가 안 돼서: The mage carrying that huge spellbook managed to get in somehow, but I left him alone since he wasn't in the way.
strings.아…, 역시 네가 길을 뚫었군. 너도 그 마법사처럼 마법청 인간이지?: Ah... So you opened a path. You're with the Magic Bureau, just like that mage, aren't you?
strings.아니야? 아니면 말고. 그러면 나에게 볼일이 없지? 돌아가는 게 좋을 거: No? Fine, then. You've no business with me, have you? You'd better leave. I have no business with you either.
strings.그게 서로 좋지 않아?: Isn't that better for both of us?
There's something I want to ask you.
strings.내가 꼭 말해야 해?: Do I have to say it?
strings.어느 정도 알고 왔으면서 뭐가 더 알고 싶다는 거야? 내가 말한다면 감당: You already know part of it. What more do you want to know? A little girl like you couldn't handle it if I told you...
strings.듣기 싫어. 인간들 틈에서 자유롭게 산 주제에 무슨 말을 하고 싶은 거야: I don't want to hear it. You've lived freely among humans. What could you possibly have to say?
Move... This has nothing to do with you.
strings.(노네임이 천천히 나르샤와 모험가를 지나쳐 가자 그의 발밑으로 거대한 마: (As No Name slowly walks past Narsha and the adventurer, a huge magic circle spreads beneath his feet.)
A magic circle made with the Magic Bureau's own spell formula. No, a magical trap.
strings.(말이 끝나기 무섭게 나르샤와 %s의 뒤에서 페타가 모습을 드러낸다.): (Before the words are out, Feta appears behind Narsha and %s.)
Thank you, adventurer. You've helped me capture No Name.
Feta, wait. If you approach him like this...
strings.모험가님, 아니 외부인은 물러나시죠. 이건 마법청의 일, 황실에서 확인된: Adventurer... No, outsider, stand back. This is Magic Bureau business. Even an identity recognized by the imperial family has no bearing on...
strings.(페타가 모험가를 향해 말을 꺼낸 순간, 노네임이 가소롭다는 듯이 웃는다: (As Feta addresses the adventurer, No Name laughs contemptuously and slowly walks toward him.)
strings.겨우 이 수준의 마법진으로 날 묶을 수 있을 거라 생각했어? 온갖 저주와: Did you think a magic circle of this caliber could restrain me? After I served as a guinea pig for every kind of curse and spell...
Damn it. Why am I even muttering about this...?
strings.(노네임의 말과 함께 방금 전까지도 없었던 존재가 그의 머리위로 나타난다: (At No Name's words, a being that was nowhere to be seen a moment ago appears above his head. It rushes toward Feta.)
strings.(미처 손쓸 틈도 없는 짧은 시간, 금속이 부딪쳐 일어난 커다란 충격이: (Before anyone can react, metal crashes against metal. The massive impact raises a thick cloud of dust and shakes the space around us.)
strings.(먼지가 사라지자 나르샤가 말했었던 노네임의 커다란 마도골렘의 모습이 드: (As the dust clears, No Name's enormous magic golem, the one Narsha described, comes into view.)
strings.(이어 페타를 공격하려고 했던 금색 빛 마도골렘의 팔이 뭔가에 붙잡혀 움: (The golden golem's arm, which had been about to strike Feta, appears to be held fast by something.)
strings.어딜 도망가?: Where do you think you're going?
strings.(노네임의 한마디에 마도골렘이 자신을 붙잡고 있던 나르샤의 마도리를 뿌리: (At No Name's command, the golem shakes off Narsha's Madori and aims the Gatling gun mounted on its arm at Feta's fleeing back.)
strings.(모험가가 무기를 들어 마도골렘을 공격하고, 나르샤의 지시로 마도리가 방: (The adventurer attacks the magic golem with their weapon. At Narsha's command, Madori acts as a shield, blocking the Gatling gun's bullets.)
strings.(그렇게 페타가 도망가버리자 노네임의 표정이 굳어버린다. 마도골렘이 노네: (As Feta escapes, No Name's expression hardens. The golem stops moving and steps back in response.)
Enough playing around. Keep getting in my way, and I'll kill you both.
strings.사람을 죽여야 할 정도로 뭘 원하는 건데?: What do you want so badly that you have to kill people?
To pay them back for the pain I suffered.
The mages? The council's nobles? Everyone connected to the Empire...
strings.(위험한 녀석이야, 막아야 해…. 이리스가 나르샤를 부탁한 것도 이런 이: (He's dangerous. I have to stop him... Is this why Iris asked me to look after Narsha?)
strings.(노네임의 분노어린 목소리가 계속해서 이어지자 보다 못한 나르샤가 소리를: (As No Name continues speaking in anger, Narsha can bear no more and shouts.)
strings.인간 사이에서 아무렇지도 않게 자란 주제에…. 나르샤라는 이름도 있으면서: You've grown up comfortably among humans... You even have a name. Narsha...
strings.넌 왜 그 골렘을 가지고 있다고 생각해? 마법청 인간들이 왜 마법청으로: Why do you think you have that golem? Do you know why the Magic Bureau's humans called you 'back' there?
strings.네가 마도린지 뭔지 하는 골렘의 적임자가 아니었다면 어떻게 됐을까? 나와: What would have happened if you hadn't been suited to that golem, Madori or whatever? You'd be like me... Hehehe...
There's your answer. Stay out of my way.
Even so, that doesn't give you a reason to kill everyone.
strings.(노네임이 귀를 쫑긋거리다가 어딘가를 바라본다.): (No Name's ears prick up, and he looks off somewhere.)
strings.이제 나타난 건가? 느껴져…. 그동안 상황을 살피고 숨죽이고 있었던 거군: So you've finally appeared? I can feel it... You've been hiding, quietly watching what happened.
So you don't care how it turns out...?
strings.(알 수 없는 말을 이어가던 노네임이 마도골렘 위에 올라탄다.): (Still muttering cryptically, No Name climbs onto his magic golem.)
Licaria. What we're looking for is over there. Let's go...
strings.(노네임이 뭔가에 홀린 것처럼 그대로 리카리아라고 부른 마도골렘에 탑승한: (As though entranced, No Name boards the magic golem he calls Licaria.)
strings.(%s의 외침을 뒤로 한 채, 마도골렘 리카리아가 하늘 위로 날아올라 모: (Ignoring %s's cry, the magic golem Licaria rises into the sky and disappears.)
strings.(모험가와 함께 하늘을 바라보던 나르샤의 귀가 쫑긋거린다.): (As Narsha watches the sky with the adventurer, her ears twitch.)
I hear a loud sound. Over there...
That's the way we came. Um, Narsha...
strings.노네임이 찾는 게 뭔지 아직 알 수 없지만, 우리가 먼저 찾아봐요. 그러: We still don't know what No Name is looking for, but let's find it first. Then we'll know what it is.
strings.(노네임을 만나기 전 잠깐 머물렀던 장소로 돌아오자 나르샤의 귀가 더 바: (Back at the place where we briefly stopped before meeting No Name, Narsha's ears grow even busier.)
strings.(%s에게는 들리지 않는 것 때문인지 나르샤의 표정이 계속해서 변한다.): (Narsha's expression keeps changing, perhaps because of something %s cannot hear.)
It isn't loud. I can't quite describe it...
strings.(나르샤가 고개를 들어 이리저리 주위를 둘러본다.): (Narsha raises her head and looks around.)
strings.여러 방향에서 소리가 들려오고 있는데, 저기선 절 부르고 있는 것 같아요: Sounds are coming from several directions, but over there... I think they're calling me...
strings.저쪽으로 먼저 가봐도 될까요?: Could we go that way first?
strings.(나르샤를 혼자 둘 순 없고, 캠프에 있으라고도 할 수 없으니….): (I can't leave Narsha alone, and I can't tell her to stay at the camp...)
I promise I won't be a burden. I have Madori too.
strings.(나르샤의 어깨에 있던 마도골렘 마도리가 알았다는 듯이 몸을 흔든다.): (The magic golem Madori on Narsha's shoulder rocks its body as though acknowledging her words.)
Madori seems more active than before.
strings.그렇죠? 흐음…. 확실히 미노스 님께서 주신 옷을 입으니 마도리의 기분이: Doesn't he? Hmm... Since I put on the clothes Lord Minos gave me, I can definitely sense Madori's feelings more clearly.
strings.(나르샤가 앞서 나가고, 모험가가 따라가려는 순간, 알 수 없는 느낌이: (Narsha goes ahead. Just as the adventurer is about to follow, an unfamiliar feeling approaches.)
strings.(이 불길한 느낌은…. 마치 기록을 봤을 때와 비슷한….): (This ominous feeling... It's like when I saw the record...)
strings.(침착하게 행동하자. 그렇지 않으면 노네임을 찾을 수 없어….): (Stay calm. Otherwise, I won't be able to find No Name...)
There's a door here. But there's a cliff right in front of it...
strings.(문에 정령 날개 같은 게 달려 있네. 분명 저 안에서 마력이 느껴져.): (The door has something like spirit wings attached to it. I can definitely feel magic from inside.)
Why are you calling me? I... I...
strings.(나르샤가 손을 뻗자 문이 흔들린다. 잠시 후, 안에서 세찬 바람이 흘러: (Narsha reaches out, and the door trembles. A moment later, a fierce wind pours out.)
strings.(버틸 수 없을 정도로 강한 바람이야….): (The wind is too strong to withstand...)
strings.(바람이 잠잠해져서 앞을 바라보자, 믿을 수 없는 광경이 눈 앞에 펼쳐진: (As the wind eases and I look ahead, an unbelievable sight unfolds. The wind from the door has lifted Narsha into the air and surrounds her.)
strings.(모험가가 서둘러 손을 뻗어 나르샤를 붙잡으려고 하는 순간, 바람은 그대: (The adventurer hurriedly reaches for Narsha, but the wind seizes them both and sends them flying into the world beyond the door.)
strings.(눈깜짝할 사이에 바람이 사라지면서 붙잡혔던 모험가가 허공에서 바닥으로: (In the blink of an eye, the wind disappears, dropping the adventurer from the air to the ground.)
strings.갑자기 바람이 우리를 여기로 날려 보냈는데 어, 나르샤?: The wind suddenly blew us here... Huh? Narsha?
strings.(정신을 차려 주위를 둘러보지만 나르샤의 모습은 보이지 않는다.): (I come to my senses and look around, but Narsha is nowhere to be seen.)
strings.나르샤? 나르샤…가 없어. 어디에 있는 거지? 그보다 여기는 어디야?: Narsha? Narsha... is gone. Where is she? For that matter, where am I?
strings.(문 안으로 들어온 세계는 조금 전까지 환한 빛으로 가득했던 오르카리움과: (The world beyond the door is utterly different from the brightly lit Orcarium of moments before.)
strings.(위에서 아래로 뻗은 기둥이 파괴되어 있고, 땅에는 불길한 색을 품은 수: (Columns stretching downward from above lie broken, and strange walls of an ominous color stand upon the ground.)
A cave? No, that isn't it. This is...
I never wanted to see it again... Yet this place has opened...
strings.(갑자기 들려오는 목소리에 주위를 둘러보자 금발에 빛나는 눈동자를 가진: (I look around at the sudden voice. A young man with blond hair and shining eyes slowly appears.)
strings.신께서 열지 않는 한 볼 수 없던 장소가 다시 열린 건 아마도…. 그래,: A place no one could see unless a god opened it has opened again. Perhaps... No, I was mistaken... I'd hoped...
strings.(청년의 등 뒤에서 차갑고 날카로운 날개가 튀어 나온다. 그리고 그 주위: (Cold, sharp wings emerge from the young man's back. Orbs of light rise around him, illuminating the surroundings.)
strings.고대신의 축복을 받은 네게 예를 표해야겠지만, 그러고 싶진 않군. 불청객: I should pay my respects to one blessed by an ancient god, but I have no desire to. You've even brought an unwelcome guest...
I am El-Larsa, follower of Orca.
El-Larsa? Ah, I've heard your voice in the El Anor Mountains.
strings.여기를 잘 알고 있는 것 같은데, 좀 도와주시겠어요? 사람을 찾아야 해요: You seem to know this place well. Would you help me? I need to find someone.
strings.(엘-라르사의 표정이 굳어지면서 주위에서 맴돌고 있던 빛의 구가 길고 커: (El-Larsa's expression hardens. The orbs circling him become long, enormous spears. At a gesture, one flies past %s's side.)
I have no desire to take such orders from you. Though I have no reason to kill a human...
Instead, I will make you one promise.
Go back. I will not harm one who is merely a tool of the gods.
strings.네가 이 약속을 깨버린다면 이야기는 다를 것이다. 오르카 님께서도 허락한: If you break this agreement, things will be different. Lord Orca has permitted it...
I can't leave. I have to find Narsha...
strings.그것이 마녀의 부정한 기운과 정령의 힘이 뒤섞여 태어난 혼종인가?: Is that the hybrid born of a witch's tainted aura mixed with the power of spirits?
Forcing open the sealed Enteleche of Life and trespassing within... I will not let this stand...
strings.(엘-라르사의 말이 끝나자 그의 주위에 맴돌던 빛의 구가 섬광으로 변해: (As El-Larsa finishes, the orbs around him turn into bursts of blinding light.)
strings.(섬광이 가라앉으면서 엘-라르사가 '생명의 엔텔레케'라고 했던 장소의 모: (As the flashes subside, the place El-Larsa called the 'Enteleche of Life' comes back into view.)
strings.나르샤를 '혼종'으로 인식하다니…. 나르샤는 정령이 말한 그런게 아닐텐데: He sees Narsha as a 'hybrid'...? She can't be what that spirit described... Ah...
strings.노네임…, 노네임이 여기에 있는건가?: No Name... Is No Name here?
Narsha is in danger. I have to find her quickly.
strings.(생명의 엔텔레케를 헤매던 중, 공간을 가득 채우는 굉음이 들려온다.): (As I wander the Enteleche of Life, a deafening noise fills the space.)
strings.정령들이 여기라고 이야기하고 있는데 왜 없어?! 방해하는 악마들도 다 없: The spirits keep saying it's here. Why isn't it?! I even cleared out all the devils in my way. Why isn't it here?!
strings.(노네임의 지시에 따라 마도골렘 리카리아가 눈 앞의 기둥과 벽을 파괴하고: (At No Name's command, the magic golem Licaria smashes the columns and walls before it.)
How did you get in? Without a spirit's power, this place...
As long as you're here, both you and Narsha are in danger. We have to leave.
The spirit guarding this place might kill you both.
If he wants to kill me, he must see me as a hybrid. Tch.
strings.(엘-라르사가 혼종이라고 한 걸 알고 있어….): (He knows El-Larsa called him a hybrid...)
You heard it too? That spirit calling me a hybrid... Can't be helped.
Narsha won't be safe until you leave.
You and that little girl... Humans who can live alongside everyone else...
No Name, get a hold of yourself...
strings.됐어. 네 이야긴 듣지 않겠어. 나는, 나는!! 나는…!!: Enough. I won't listen to you. I... I!! I...!!
strings.필요한 걸 찾는 것뿐이라고!!: I'm just looking for what I need!!
strings.(거대한 소리와 함께 마도골렘 리카리아가 모험가의 앞으로 떨어진다.): (With a thunderous crash, the enormous magic golem Licaria lands in front of the adventurer.)
strings.(마도골렘 리카리아의 움직임이 느려지고, 부속으로 보이는 파편들이 땅에: (The magic golem Licaria's movements slow, and pieces that look like components fall to the ground.)
strings.(골렘을 몇 번 상대해보긴 했지만, 리카리아는 차원이 달라. 이대로 무너: (I've fought golems before, but Licaria is on another level. I can't fall here...)
Why won't you give up? Licaria, one final attack...
strings.(노네임이 당황한 모습으로 비틀거리는 마도골렘 리카리아를 바라본다.): (No Name looks in alarm at the staggering magic golem Licaria.)
strings.(노네임이 마도골렘 리카리아의 상태를 살피려고 다가간 순간, 마도골렘이: (The moment No Name approaches to examine Licaria, the golem releases a huge explosion, sending him and the adventurer flying.)
strings.(정신을 차린 모험가와 노네임이 리카리아를 바라보자 허공에 있던 기둥과: (When the adventurer and No Name recover and look at Licaria, a column from above and the wall behind have already collapsed onto it.)
Could it be... To save No Name...
strings.(나르샤를 구하려고 했던 마도리의 움직임을 생각하면 리카리아도 그런 행동: (Considering how Madori tried to save Narsha, Licaria must have done the same.)
strings.(그때, 쓰러진 돌무더기 사이에서 마도골렘 리카리아가 천천히 떠오른다.): (Then the magic golem Licaria slowly rises from the fallen rubble.)
Let's stop here for today. My efforts have just come to nothing.
strings.(노네임의 외침과 함께 마도골렘 리카리아가 허공으로 오르더니 들고 있던: (At No Name's cry, Licaria rises into the air and throws the axe it holds toward a distant wall.)
strings.(벽에 부딪칠 거라 생각된 리카리아의 도끼가 천천히 떠오른다. 잠시 후,: (The axe, seemingly about to strike the wall, slowly floats upward. A moment later, the beings holding it become visible.)
So I have to watch the sleeping golems and spirit eggs awaken because of that little girl...
strings.(미니 골렘들이 리카리아의 도끼를 다른 곳으로 던져버리는 동안, 언제 나: (While the miniature golems throw Licaria's axe aside, Narsha appears from somewhere and approaches %s.)
strings.저는 괜찮은데, 나르샤는 그동안 어디 있었던 거예요. 아무리 찾아도 보이: I'm fine, but where have you been, Narsha? I couldn't find you anywhere...
strings.이 안으로 이끈 바람이 이게 있는 곳에 떨어뜨렸어요. 손대고 싶진 않았지: The wind that brought us inside dropped me where this was. I didn't want to touch it, but it seemed to be calling me...
strings.엔텔레케의 힘이 새겨진 파편, 내가 그걸 가져야 했는데…. 이곳의 정령들: A fragment engraved with Enteleche's power. I was supposed to have it... But the spirits here seem to have wanted your company more than mine...
strings.(노네임이 체념한 표정으로 나르샤를 바라본다.): (No Name looks at Narsha with resignation.)
strings.꼬맹이가 다시 이곳에 오지 못하게 겁을 줬었는데, 이 인간을 달고 오다니: I frightened you so you wouldn't come back here. And then you brought this human... You've ruined everything.
No Name, what is this power? You know, don't you?
strings.그래, 이렇게 된 거. 이야기해주지…. 그건 엘-라르사의 영역에 남아있는: Fine. Since it's come to this, I'll tell you... It's the power of the spirits that remains in El-Larsa's domain. The dying spirits need it to live again.
El-Larsa is the spirit of light who guards Orcarium.
strings.잠깐만요. 그 힘을 제가 가진 게 되는 거예요?: Wait a moment. Does that mean I have that power now?
strings.그래, 꼬맹아. 축하해! 좋은 선물을 받았다고 생각하라고. 지금 그 정령: Yes, little girl. Congratulations! Consider it a lovely present. Right now, that spirit is hunting desperately for hybrids like us. To kill us and wipe us out.
strings.안 그래도 지금 엘-라르사의 심사가 뒤틀렸을 거야. 잠든 사이에 마법청: El-Larsa must already be in a foul mood. While he was asleep, the Magic Bureau's humans turned all of Orcarium upside down.
strings.그런데, 그 힘을 가져간 게 마법청에서 골렘을 깨운 너라면 어떻게 될까?: And what will happen when he learns that the one who took his power is you, who awakened a golem at the Magic Bureau? Hahahaha!
It's infuriating, but a little funny...
You need to understand. Awakening a magic golem and becoming its master is no blessing.
strings.(할말이 끝난 노네임이 제자리에서 뛰어올라 기다리고 있던 마도골렘 리카리: (Having said his piece, No Name jumps up and grabs the waiting Licaria.)
I'd rather not see that human again. Sigh...
Oh, before I go, let me tell our spirit friend something he's been wondering about.
strings.당신이 찾고 있던 오르카는 죽었어. 고대신들에게 살해당했다고. 그리고 그: The Orca you've been looking for is dead. Murdered by the ancient gods. And some of that power passed to humans... Gah...
strings.(갑자기 거대한 빛의 화살이 날아와 노네임의 흉부를 관통한 후, 그대로: (Suddenly, an enormous arrow of light flies through No Name's chest and embeds itself in the wall.)
strings.(주인을 잃어버려 움직임을 멈춘 마도골렘 리카리아가 그대로 노네임과 함께: (With its master lost, Licaria stops moving and falls alongside No Name.)
strings.(이어 그 모습을 지켜보고 있었던 것처럼 생명의 엔텔레케를 뒤흔드는 엘-: (Then El-Larsa's voice shakes the Enteleche of Life, as though he had been watching all along.)
I've heard something I never wished to hear.
strings.(목소리가 사라지자 쓰러진 노네임의 앞으로 빛의 정령 엘-라르사가 모습을: (As the voice fades, El-Larsa, the spirit of light, appears before the fallen No Name.)
strings.정령들이 말했어요. 오르카리움을 지키는 빛의 정령의 이름을…. 엘-라르사: The spirits told me the name of the light spirit who guards Orcarium... El-Larsa...
...Narsha, stand back. El-Larsa seems different from the other spirits...
strings.(엘-라르사가 경계하는 모험가와 나르샤를 공허한 눈빛으로 바라본다.): (El-Larsa regards the wary adventurer and Narsha with empty eyes.)
strings.(헤이든처럼 다른 힘에 취해 있는 걸까?): (Is he intoxicated by another power, like Hayden was?)
strings.나는 이 자리를 지키는 정령. 해야 할 일을 했다…. 정령이 태어나는 장: I am the spirit who guards this place. I did what was required... Judgment upon one who destroyed the birthplace of spirits.
strings.네가 가져간 그 힘이 무엇인지 아느냐. 죽어가는 정령들이 다시 태어날 힘: Do you know what power you have taken? It is the power that allows dying spirits to be reborn.
strings.제가 가져간 게 아니에요. 이곳에 있는 정령들이 제게 맡겼어요. 이곳이: I didn't take it. The spirits here entrusted it to me. They said this place was corrupted and asked me to keep it somewhere safe...
strings.불쾌해…. 신도 아니고, 고작 인간의 언어로 나를 설득하려 하다니…. 정: Disgusting... You are no god, yet you try to persuade me with mere human words... Just because spirits aid life does not mean you may do as you please!!
strings.이곳이 오염됐든 아니든, 그 힘은 이 장소, 그 자체. 혼종들이 탐낼만: Corrupted or not, that power is this place itself. No wonder hybrids would covet it. I, El-Larsa, its guardian, will reclaim it in my own way.
strings.신의 가호를 받는 자와 엔텔레케의 힘을 취한 혼종을 재료로 이곳을 영원히: I will use one blessed by the gods and the hybrid who took Enteleche's power to seal this place forever. So that even the gods cannot approach...
strings.(모험가와 나르샤가 뭐라 할 틈도 없이 조소를 머금은 엘-라르사의 모습이: (Before the adventurer or Narsha can reply, El-Larsa vanishes with a mocking smile. Soon the ground beneath everyone begins to shake and crack.)
strings.(갈라진 틈으로 검은 그림자가 올라와 눈앞에 있는 것들을 차츰 삼키기 시: (Black shadows rise through the fissures, slowly swallowing everything before them.)
It's not an earthquake! Narsha, we have to leave, now!
strings.노네임을 데리고 나가야 해요…. 빨리 치료하면…. 말이 안 되는 걸 아는: We have to bring No Name... If we treat him quickly... I know it makes no sense, but still...
strings.설명하긴 힘들지만, 이곳은 오르카리움의 이면 같은 곳이에요. 빨리 나가지: It's hard to explain, but this place is like Orcarium's Reverse Side. If we don't leave quickly, we'll be trapped forever. We might even die here...
strings.(나르샤가 검은 그림자 속에 삼켜지는 노네임과 마도골렘 리카리아를 멍하니: (Narsha stares blankly as the black shadows swallow No Name and Licaria.)
strings.아, 죄송해요. 그러면 절 따라오세요. 정령들이 저쪽으로 가면 나가는 길: Ah, I'm sorry. Follow me, then. The spirits say there's a way out over there!!
strings.(정신을 차린 나르샤가 %s의 손을 붙잡는다. 그리고 삼킬듯이 쫓아오는: (Coming to her senses, Narsha grabs %s's hand. They run toward a faint light, fleeing the black shadows that pursue them, ready to devour them.)
strings.(밖으로 흐르는 바람을 따라 빛이 보이는 곳으로 계속해서 달려간 결과,: (Following the wind flowing outward and running toward the light, the two finally escape.)
strings.…밖으로 나오긴 했지만, 아직도 생명의 엔텔레케의 문은 남아있구나. 나르: ...We're outside, but the door to the Enteleche of Life is still there. Narsha, are you all right?
strings.(나르샤가 숨을 고르며 괜찮다는 표정을 짓지만, 조금 힘들어 보인다.): (Narsha catches her breath and tries to look reassuring, but she seems to be struggling.)
strings.마도리, 난 괜찮아. 자, 봐. 괜찮지?: Madori, I'm fine. See? I'm all right, aren't I?
strings.모험가님도 이런 일을 많이 겪으셨겠죠?: You've been through a lot of things like this too, haven't you?
A few times. But many people helped me, and I got through them.
strings.저도 그럴 수 있을까요?: Will I be able to do that too?
You're doing well. Don't worry too much.
strings.그야 당연하죠. 미노스 님이 나르샤를 일족의 아이라고 부르셨고, 메디아: Of course you're not. Lord Minos called you a child of his people, and Lady Medea seems to recognize something about you too.
The Kali tribe seem connected to spirits as well...
From what the spirits tell me... El-Larsa seems to have misunderstood what I am.
strings.그리고 제가 사랑 받아서 태어났다고, 골렘을 잘 다루는 아이라고 해줬어요: They said I was born out of love, and that I'm a child with a gift for handling golems.
But No Name was different from me...
strings.노네임에 대한 건 내가 알아볼게요. 나르샤는 지금 나르샤만 신경 쓰면 돼: I'll find out about No Name. For now, just focus on yourself, Narsha.
strings.그런데 정령들이 그런 이야기를 해줘요?: The spirits tell you things like that?
strings.네, 엔텔레케의 파편을 쥔 순간부터 목소리가 더 선명하게 들려와요. 그냥: Yes. Ever since I took hold of the Enteleche fragment, I can hear their voices more clearly. It's simply comforting.
strings.엘-라르사가 오해하는 것 같아요. 생명의 엔텔레케를 연 것은 노네임이 아: El-Larsa seems to have misunderstood. No Name didn't open the Enteleche of Life, and I'm not a hybrid...
strings.그런데, 관리자라는 정령이 이런 사실을 모를 수 있나요?: But could a spirit who guards this place really not know those things?
The spirits said they entrusted the Enteleche fragment to me for the sake of this place.
strings.(나르샤에게 인간에게 해를 입히려던 정령의 이야기를 전한다.): (I tell Narsha about a spirit that tried to harm humans.)
strings.엘-라르사가 오염됐을 수도 있단 말씀이시죠?: You mean El-Larsa might be corrupted?
I'm not certain... But I should meet him again.
strings.엘-라르사처럼 강한 정령이 오염된 상태면 내버려둘 수 없어요. 이리스에게: If a spirit as powerful as El-Larsa is corrupted, we can't leave him like that. It could be bad for Iris too...
I hear a spirit's voice. This is... Ugh, uuuugh... Ngh...
strings.(나르샤가 귀를 쫑긋거려 정령의 목소리를 듣다가 갑자기 고통스러워한다.): (Narsha pricks up her ears to listen to the spirit's voice, then suddenly doubles over in pain.)
strings.(마도리가 날아올라 두 팔로 나르샤의 귀를 막는다.): (Madori flies up and covers Narsha's ears with both arms.)
Adventurer. El-Larsa asked me to give you a message.
He said to come alone to the [Spirit Stump]...
strings.할 이야기가 있는 건가? 어쩌면 좋은 기회일 수도 있겠네요. 엘-라르사가: Does he have something to say? This might be a good opportunity. If he's waiting there, I don't think he'll come outside.
strings.안 돼요. 위험해요. 오르카리움을 지키는 정령이라 어떤 식으로 위협할지: No. It's dangerous. He's the spirit who guards Orcarium. We don't know how he might threaten us, so we have to be careful.
Narsha, listen to me for now. Think only about yourself.
strings.지금도 정령의 목소리가 들려요?: Can you still hear the spirits?
They're quiet, but I think they'll answer if I speak to them.
strings.페타가 아직 오르카리움에 있는지 물어봐 줄래요?: Could you ask whether Feta is still in Orcarium?
They say he's still at camp.
strings.그래요? 그러면 나르샤, 여기서 날 기다리는 동안 만약 돌아오지 않으면: Is he? Then wait here for me, Narsha. If I don't return, go to the camp.
strings.마법청 사람들도 생각이 있어서 거기에다 캠프를 설치했을 거예요. 게다가: The Magic Bureau must have had a reason to set up camp there. And Feta is a capable mage...
strings.나는 걱정하지 않아도 돼요. 이리스가 있으니까요. 지금까지 잘 버텼으니까: You don't need to worry about me. I have Iris. I've made it this far, so things will work out somehow this time too.
strings.네, 그렇게까지 말씀하시면 어쩔 수 없잖아요. 제가 다시 말리기 전에 빨: All right. When you put it like that, what can I say? Go quickly, before I try to stop you again.
All right. Madori, take good care of Narsha.
strings.(마도리가 알았다는 듯 움직이자 그 모습을 확인한 모험가가 서둘러 정령의: (Madori moves as though acknowledging the request. Seeing this, the adventurer hurries toward the Spirit Stump.)
I didn't even get to tell the adventurer to be careful.
Madori... Could you have been a spirit too...?
strings.(초록색 정령의 날개가 달린 문을 열고 들어가자 시야에 들어오는 풍경이: (Opening the door with green spirit wings and stepping inside, I find the scenery has changed.)
strings.(어두운 하늘을 향해 길게 뻗어 있는 나무들과 그 밑으로 맑은 물이 흐르: (In this unfamiliar place, tall trees stretch toward a dark sky, with clear water flowing beneath them. Yet unlike Orcarium, it seems devoid of life.)
So this is the Spirit Stump... Though I don't see any actual tree stumps...
Why do all the plants look dead...? Orcarium is so beautiful.
strings.(이렇게 혼잣말하면 한 번쯤 대답을 해줄 것도 같은데, 여기선 그렇지 않: (I almost expect her to answer when I talk to myself like this. But here, she doesn't...)
strings.(여기선 이리스의 힘이 닿지 않는 걸까…?): (Does Iris's power not reach this place...?)
strings.(잎이라고는 하나도 없는 초라한 고목들 사이에서 엘-라르사가 천천히 걸어: (El-Larsa slowly emerges from among the wretched, leafless old trees.)
This is a place the goddess still cannot see.
strings.고대신들이 얼마 없던 이 별을 위해 신이 된 일은 고귀하다. 그렇게 고귀: Becoming a god for this star, where so few ancient gods remained, was a noble deed. I do not resent one who has acted so nobly.
Then I wish you would stop what you're planning, El-Larsa.
Do you even know what I intend to do? I cannot stop.
strings.혹시. 다른 힘 때문에 오염된 건가요?: Could you have been corrupted by another power?
That happens only to weak beings. You underestimate me.
strings.대체 왜 그러는 거죠?: Then why are you doing this?
strings.나는 정령이다. 눈을 뜬 순간부터 신과 생명을 위해 사는 존재…. 난 나: I am a spirit. From the moment I opened my eyes, I have lived for the gods and for life... I must do my work. I must protect this place and keep it alive. That is my mission...
Even if you are blessed by a god, even if you are here by a god's will...
strings.이곳에서 일어난 너희들의 죄를 물으려 한다. 이건 이리스 여신조차도, 가: I will hold you accountable for your sins here. This is mine alone to do. Neither Goddess Iris nor Goddess Gaia may interfere...
strings.(모험가가 무기를 들려는 순간, 엘-라르사가 주위에 있던 빛의 구를 폭발: (As the adventurer reaches for their weapon, El-Larsa detonates the surrounding orbs of light, stopping them.)
strings.지금 네가 나에게 공격을 가한다면…. 생명의 힘으로 태어나는 정령의 나무: If you attack me now... all the spirit trees born of life's power will die.
And then no more spirits will be born...
I will wait deep within the Spirit Stump. Come there.
strings.정해진 시간 안에 도착하지 않는다면, 이곳을 비롯해 반경 일정 거리 안에: If you do not arrive within the allotted time, every human within a certain radius of this place will die.
I have no desire to do it, but that much should be necessary to make you come.
strings.그곳에서 기다리겠다. 물론, 날 만나러 오는 길은 쉽지 않을 것이다. 이: I will wait there. Of course, the path to me will not be easy. The beings remaining here will support my decision.
Why is El-Larsa trying to do something so senseless...?
strings.(부서진 정령의 날개와 물길이 뒤섞여 기묘한 분위기를 자아내는 길의 마지: (At the end of an uncanny path of broken spirit wings and waterways, El-Larsa waits beside the stump of what was once a great tree.)
Many devils and demons must have drifted in here. You have done well to reach me.
strings.엘-라르사, 내 말을 들어봐요. 이런 싸움이 무슨 의미가 있죠?!: El-Larsa, listen to me. What's the point of this fight?!
strings.여기까지 오면서도 날 설득할 마음이 남아있다니…. 맘에 안 들어. 신이: You've come all this way and still intend to persuade me... I don't like it. A human favored by a god, filled with arrogance from head to toe...
strings.모든 것이 네 뜻대로 될 줄 아느냐…. 일이란 건 내가 원한다고 해서 모: Do you think everything will go your way? Things do not happen simply because you want them to.
strings.나 같은 정령도 그렇고, 인간인 너도 그런 적이 있을 것이다. 그리고 이: That is true for a spirit like me, and you must have experienced it too. So has this world. Memories of suffering and ruin no one wanted...
