After the twilight ended, in the age when the being called the Demon King nearly extinguished the continent's light... Fortunately, the light survived.
strings.세레스 님과 가이아 님, 그리고 남은 소수의 신이 지킨 건 생명뿐만 아니: Lady Seres, Lady Gaia, and the few remaining gods protected not only life, but the source of light as well.
strings.세계를 비추는 원초적인 빛의 힘은 생명 뿐만 아니라 정령을 태어나게 했고: The primordial light illuminating the world gave birth not only to life, but to spirits, and sustained them. It kept them from being swallowed by corrupted darkness.
I guarded the light here, waiting for Lord Orca...
strings.이 장소가 보존되는 동안, 이 땅의 많은 생명들이 힘을 보탰다. 지성이: While this place endured, many living beings of this land lent their strength. They were intelligent beings who followed the gods.
strings.오랫동안 그들을 지켜봤다. 가이아 님께서 하시는 것처럼…. 하지만, 그들: I watched over them for a long time, as Lady Gaia did... But in an instant, they split apart.
strings.프레이오스가 신들의 욕심 때문에 갈라진 것처럼 그들은 하늘을 어둠으로 가: Just as Freios had been torn apart by the gods' greed, they fought as though they meant to fill the sky with darkness.
strings.순식간에 수인의 영역이 순식간에 증발했고, 실바리아라고 했던 제국의 병사: In an instant, the beastfolk territory vanished, and the soldiers of the empire called Silvaria swallowed all of Freios.
strings.그리고 생명을 지키기 위해서 만들어진 태초의 골렘이 이곳을 침범하고 파괴: Then the primordial golems, created to protect life, invaded this place and destroyed it.
strings.덕분에 모두 죽어갔지. 누군가의 계획이었다. 빛의 근원이 있는 걸 아는…: Everything began to die. It was someone's plan. Someone who knew the source of light was here...
strings.내가 영원히 빠져 나올 수 없는 그런 곳에 가뒀으니까. 그렇게 그들은 죽: I imprisoned them somewhere they could never escape. And so they became nourishment for this dying place...
W-wait a moment. What do you mean...?
strings.정령은 인간의 일에 개입하지 않는다. 하지만, 인간들이 선을 넘는 경우엔: Spirits do not interfere in human affairs. But it is different when humans cross the line.
strings.엔텔레케의 파편으로 빛의 근원에 닿은 크리드의 아이, 신의 축복을 받는: A child of Creed who reached the source of light through an Enteleche fragment, and one blessed by a god... The two of you should be enough.
I, El-Larsa, am charged with protecting Orcarium according to Lord Orca's will...
strings.(엘-라르사의 주위에 있던 빛의 구가 그의 손 끝으로 흘러간다.): (The orbs of light around El-Larsa flow toward his fingertips.)
strings.(잠시 후, 빛은 커다란 창 모양으로 변한다. 그리고 엘-라르사의 손짓에: (Soon, the light forms an enormous spear. At El-Larsa's gesture, it flies toward the adventurer.)
Goddess Iris. Let your adventurer be buried here...
strings.(엘-라르사가 지친 표정의 모험가와 모험가에 의해 상처를 입은 날개를 번: (El-Larsa looks between the exhausted adventurer and the wing they have wounded.)
I acknowledge that you are strong enough to face me, and remarkably persistent.
Hah, hah... This isn't over yet.
strings.어리석은 인간…. 아직도 버티는군. 겨우 신의 도구일 뿐이면서…. 도구…: Foolish human... Still resisting. You are merely a god's tool... A tool...
strings.엘-라르사…? 설마 신을 원망하는 건가요?: El-Larsa...? Do you resent the gods?
strings.신을 원망하는 것이 아니다. 신의 뜻대로 행동하는 것뿐이지. 그래, 사실: I do not resent the gods. I merely act according to their will. Yes, perhaps it truly makes no difference who you are...
strings.내가 이곳에 있는 이유는 그것뿐이니까. 생명을 위해서 존재하던 이들이 기: That is my only reason for being here. Though I do not know whether those who existed for the sake of life would rejoice...
strings.(시공간 네트워크에서 확인했었던 데이터의 내용이….): (The data I saw in the spacetime network...)
N-no... I can't die just as it showed...
What strange words. As though you've seen a future in which you die. Let us end this.
strings.(엘-라르사의 말과 함께 공간 안에 있던 빛이 모두 빠른 속도로 %s에게: (At El-Larsa's words, all the light in the space rushes toward %s.)
strings.(누군가를 향한 그리움이 가득 담긴 이름이 불리자 빛은 거대한 창으로 변: (As he speaks a name filled with longing, the light becomes an enormous spear and flies toward %s.)
strings.(나, 난 이대로 죽는 걸까…?): (A-am I going to die like this...?)
strings.(지금까지와 다른 죽음의 공포가 다가오면서 모험가가 눈을 질끈 감는다.): (Faced with a fear of death unlike any before, the adventurer squeezes their eyes shut.)
(At that moment, a light so immense that its pressure can be felt through closed eyes approaches. A moment later, an explosion sounds.)
strings.(조심스레 눈을 뜬 %s의 시야가 환한 빛으로 가득 차 있다. 그리고 하: (%s cautiously opens their eyes to a view filled with brilliant light. Above, the spear of light has been deflected by something and sent flying into the sky.)
strings.빛을 감싸 안은 밤의 달…? 밤의 달이 여기 있을 리가…?: The night moon that embraces light...? The night moon cannot be here...?
strings.(엘-라르사가 하늘 위로 튕겨나간 빛의 창을 붙잡고 빛의 섬광 사이 어딘: (El-Larsa catches the spear that was knocked skyward and lunges toward %s, somewhere amid the flashes of light.)
strings.(모든 힘을 담은 엘-라르사의 공격이 %s에게 향하는 순간, 방금 전과는: (The instant El-Larsa's full-force attack reaches %s, a light incomparably stronger than before erupts, shaking all of Orcarium.)
strings.(엘-라르사가 체념한 듯 그대로 주저앉는다. 잠시 후, 정령의 그루터기: (El-Larsa sinks to the ground in resignation. Soon the light that had engulfed the Spirit Stump fades.)
strings.(그리고 그 사이에서 피를 흘리는 누군가의 모습이 드러난다.): (Within it, the figure of someone bleeding is revealed.)
strings.(이리스가 애써 미소짓고 있지만, 어깨에 박힌 빛의 창 때문에 고통을 숨: (Iris forces a smile, but cannot hide the pain from the spear of light lodged in her shoulder.)
I'm glad I wasn't too late.
strings.이리스, 이리스!! 괜찮아?!: Iris! Iris!! Are you all right?!
You always say that, Iris. But you're not really all right.
There was no time... If I'd been late, what might have happened...
strings.(엘-라르사가 만들었던 빛의 창이 힘을 잃고 천천히 사라진다. 그러자 이: (The spear of light El-Larsa created loses its power and slowly vanishes. The bleeding from Iris's shoulder stops.)
I came because I didn't want something to happen that I would regret.
This was entirely my own choice. Please respect my wishes.
The future I saved for you, %s, will continue. And...
strings.(이리스가 주저앉아 있던 엘-라르사의 이름을 부르며 손을 내민다.): (Iris calls El-Larsa's name and extends a hand to him as he sits on the ground.)
You came here knowing what would happen if I wounded you.
That was how you could save that human...
strings.제가 어찌 당신을 원망하겠습니까? 이리스 님처럼 이 세계를 아끼는 고귀한: How could I resent you? Where else is there someone as noble, who cherishes this world as you do, Lady Iris...?
strings.저는 오르카 님의 뜻을 따라 이곳과 정령들을 지키려고 했을 뿐이지만…,: I only wished to protect this place and its spirits according to Lord Orca's will...
But it seems that differed from your will, Goddess.
strings.여신님처럼 제 선택에 후회는 없습니다. 하지만, 이대로 사라지는 건 아쉽: Like you, I do not regret my choice. But I am sorry to disappear like this...
Without ever seeing Lord Orca again...
strings.(엘-라르사가 쓸쓸한 표정을 짓자 그의 몸이 조금씩 흐릿해진다.): (A lonely expression crosses El-Larsa's face, and his body slowly begins to fade.)
strings.주인 되는 신을 상처입힌 정령, 엘-라르사. 섭리에 어긋나는 일을 한 대: I, El-Larsa, am a spirit who has wounded the goddess who is my master. I willingly accept the price for defying the natural order.
Please give my regards to Lady Gaia, when she awakens someday...
strings.(빛을 품었던 정령에게서 빛이 천천히 사라져간다. 마치 처음부터 이 세계: (The light slowly leaves the spirit who once held it, as though he had never existed in this world at all...)
strings.(방금 전까지 뭔가 있었던 것 같은 자리가 유난히 어둡게 다가온다.): (The spot where something seemed to stand moments before feels especially dark.)
Lady Seres... As God of the Astral Realm, she must have made choices like this too...
strings.(모험가를 향해 쓸쓸한 미소를 보이던 이리스의 얼굴이 점차 창백해진다.): (Iris gives the adventurer a lonely smile, then her face grows steadily paler.)
strings.(이리스가 어떻게든 서 있으려고 노력하지만, 다리에 힘이 풀렸는지 그대로: (Iris struggles to remain standing, but her legs give way. She sinks down, then loses consciousness and collapses.)
Iris... Wait. I'll help you up...
strings.(모험가가 이리스에게 다가가려고 하는 순간, 땅이 흔들리고 갈라지기 시작: (As the adventurer approaches Iris, the ground begins shaking and splitting apart.)
strings.생명의 엔텔레케가 사라졌을 때와 같아…. 이리스를 구해야 해!!: It's just like when the Enteleche of Life disappeared... I have to save Iris!!
strings.(허공에서 빠른 속도로 날아온 정령 둘이 %s의 앞을 가로막는다.): (Two spirits fly swiftly through the air and block %s's path.)
We'll take care of Lady Iris. There's no time.
strings.시간이 없다뇨?: What do you mean, no time?
strings.어서 그 아이가 있는 곳으로 가라. 그렇지 않으면 모든 게 붕괴될 것이다: Go to that child at once. Otherwise, everything will collapse.
The goddess will be all right. Trust us, as we trust you.
strings.저곳으로 가면 바로 밖으로 나갈 수 있어요. 서두르세요!: Go that way, and you'll be outside immediately. Hurry!
strings.(하르모니아와 기아스가 쓰러진 이리스에게로 다가가자 알 수 없는 힘이 모: (As Harmonia and Geis approach the fallen Iris, an unknown force pushes the adventurer away. Their figures recede until they can no longer be seen.)
Iris... She'll be all right, won't she...?
They said not to worry. She'll be all right...
strings.이리스는 내 미래가 계속될 거라 했는데…, 만약 이리스가 나타나지 못했다: Iris said my future would continue... But if she hadn't been able to appear...
Was it simply the consequence of a choice...?
strings.방금 뭐였지? 오르카리움이 흔들린 것 같은데…. 마도리, 너도 느꼈지?: What was that? It felt like Orcarium shook... Madori, you felt it too, didn't you?
But why are the spirits so quiet...?
strings.(나르샤가 귀를 쫑긋거리며 귀를 매만지지만, 사라진 소리는 다시 들리지: (Narsha pricks up her ears and touches them, but the vanished sounds do not return.)
I can't hear them. Why, all of a sudden...?
strings.(그러던 중, 금방이라도 쓰러질 것 같은 표정으로 다가오는 %s의 모습이: (Then she sees %s approaching, looking ready to collapse.)
strings.모험가님! 모험가님! 괜찮으세요?: Adventurer! Adventurer! Are you all right?
Narsha? Narsha, thank goodness. You're still here.
strings.괜찮으신 거예요? 그 안에서 무슨 일이 있었던 거예요? 그 정령은요? 어: Are you all right? What happened in there? What about that spirit? You're not hurt, are you? And No Name...
Narsha, one question at a time. My head's a little muddled right now...
strings.그곳에서 무슨 일이 있었는지 이야기해줄게요. 나르샤가 이야기를 들어도 될: I'll tell you what happened there. I think it's all right for you to hear it...
When I entered the Spirit Stump...
strings.(나르샤에게 정령의 그루터기에서 엘-라르사를 만나 있었던 일을 이야기한다: (I tell Narsha what happened when I met El-Larsa at the Spirit Stump.)
With all that happening... I couldn't find out anything about No Name.
strings.(나르샤가 슬픈 표정으로 오르카리움의 하늘을 바라본다.): (Narsha looks up at Orcarium's sky with a sad expression.)
strings.제가 괜히 온다고 고집부려서 이런 일들이 일어난 건 아니겠죠? 이리스 님: This didn't all happen because I insisted on coming, did it? Even Lady Iris was...
It wasn't because of you, Narsha. It wasn't our fault... So it'll be all right.
strings.(그건 이런 일이 일어나길 바라는 존재들이겠지….): (The fault lies with those who wanted something like this to happen...)
Huh? What's this...? It wasn't there a moment ago...
strings.엘-라르사 정령님 주위에 있던 빛의 구 같아요. 모험가님을 따라 온 것: It looks like one of the orbs of light around El-Larsa. It seems to have followed you...
strings.(나르샤가 빛의 구를 인식한 순간, 나르샤의 주머니에서 엔텔레케의 파편이: (The instant Narsha notices the orb, the Enteleche fragment in her pouch begins to glow.)
strings.(나르샤가 파편을 꺼내 손에 쥐는 순간 공간을 뒤흔드는 누군가의 목소리가: (As she takes it out and holds it, someone's voice rings out, shaking the space around them.)
strings.지금 이 순간은 라르사가 영원토록 지키고자 했던 빛의 근원, 그것의 일부: What is here at this moment is part of the source of light that Larsa wished to guard for eternity.
strings.(빛과 파편 사이의 거리에서 어떤 누군가의 목소리가 흘러나온다.): (A voice flows from the space between the light and the fragment.)
And the regret of one who fell short, leaving everything to beloved Larsa...
Now the remaining light leaves Orcarium and goes to the goddess of the moon, flowers, and growing things...
%s... I have a favor to ask.
...Do not let Iris lose the light in her heart...
strings.(두 사람이 상황을 파악하기도 전에 빛은 이내 사라지고, 나르샤의 손에: (Before the two can grasp what is happening, the light vanishes. The Enteleche fragment in Narsha's hand also becomes light and disappears.)
strings.(빛이 사라진 장소에서 아무 말 없이 하늘만 바라보던 두 사람 중 먼저: (They gaze wordlessly at the sky where the light vanished. Narsha is the first to break the silence.)
strings.모험가님, 저 이제 정령의 소리가 들리지 않아요. 이 빛이 사라지면서 그: Adventurer, I can't hear the spirits anymore. It seems to have happened when that light disappeared...
Perhaps their voices faded when the light here went to Iris.
I don't know, but perhaps someone who cherished El-Larsa...
strings.(그건 그렇고 이리스는 정말 괜찮을까? 빛이 이리스에게 향했다고 말하긴: (Still, is Iris really all right? They said the light went to her, but even so...)
strings.그 힘…, 분명 여신님께 갔으니 잘 된 거겠죠? 여신님도 분명 괜찮으실: That power... It went to the goddess, so that must be a good thing, right? I'm sure she'll be all right too.
Um, I... At first, I came here because I wanted to know what I am...
strings.아니요. 많은 일들이 일어나서 좀 복잡했지만, 괜찮아요. 오히려 더 좋다: No. So much happened that it's a little overwhelming, but I'm all right. I think it's better this way.
strings.앞으로 제가 해야 할 일도 찾았고, 계속하다 보면 답을 더 찾을 수 있을: I've found things I need to do. If I keep going, perhaps I'll find more answers.
strings.복잡하게 생각하지 말고, 괜히 혼자서만 끙끙 앓지도 않을래요. 어려운 일: I won't overthink everything or struggle with it alone anymore. If something difficult happens, I'll tell you right away.
It's all thanks to you, adventurer.
strings.뭘요. 이제 돌아갈까요?: It was nothing. Shall we go back now?
strings.네, 빨리 가서 쉬고 싶어요. 그런데, 그 마법사님은 괜찮을까요?: Yes. I'd like to get back and rest. But do you think that mage is all right?
strings.캠프쪽으로 도망간 것 같은데, 가볼까요?: He seemed to run toward the camp. Shall we check?
strings.(페타가 커다란 마법서를 이불 삼아 덮고 바닥에 잠들어 있다. 게다가 꿈: (Feta is asleep on the ground, his enormous spellbook draped over him like a blanket. He even mutters strangely in his sleep, apparently dreaming.)
My magic is full... I can't eat another bite...
strings.주위에 결계 같은걸 설치했나…. 몬스터 같은게 들어오지 못하는 걸 보면…: He must have set up a barrier or something... The monsters can't seem to get in...
strings.여기서 쭉 있었나 봐요. 파견 나와서 일을 잘 해결해서 본청으로 간다고: He must have stayed here the whole time. He said he'd resolve his assignment and return to headquarters...
He'd probably be better off quitting the Magic Bureau...
I really can't figure him out...
Adventurer, the path we came through is still there.
strings.이제 에스닐로 돌아가죠. 미노스 님께 먼저 갈까요?: Let's go back to Esnil now. Should we visit Lord Minos first?
He said we didn't have to come, so I'll visit him later and explain what happened. Or we can go together.
strings.탈로스 아저씨도 무섭긴 하지만, 괜찮은 것 같고…. 초소에 있던 유격병들: Talos is frightening, but he seems all right too... Though I'm still worried about the rangers at the outpost.
strings.이 마법사님은 그냥 내버려 두고 빨리 가요. 이 상황에서도 잘도 자고 있: Let's leave this mage here and hurry back. If he can sleep this soundly in these circumstances, I'm sure he'll manage on his own.
Ahaha. Then let's head back to Esnil.
strings.(나르샤가 도착하자마자 긴장이 풀렸는지 그대로 주저앉아 버린다.): (The moment she arrives, Narsha sinks to the ground, as though all her tension has left her.)
I'm fine. It was my first time traveling so far from home. I suppose I'm finally relaxing.
Oh, Narsha... About what happened in Orcarium...
strings.네, 알고 있어요. 함부로 이야기하고 다니진 않을게요. 총장님에게는 말씀: Yes, I know. I won't go telling everyone. But it's all right to tell the president, isn't it?
strings.저도 배고픈데, 길드 여관에 가서 같이 식사 할래요?: So am I. Want to have a meal together at the Guild Inn?
strings.네, 네! 저 옷 갈아입고 나올게요. 잠깐 기다려주세요!: Yes, yes! I'll change my clothes and come out. Wait just a moment!
I'll have a meal at the inn and rest a little too...
strings.(오르카리움의 일을 다시 생각해봐야겠어. 이리스에게 별일이 없겠지만, 그: (I need to think through what happened in Orcarium. I'm sure Iris will be all right, but still...)
Madori? He's returned to his original black color too.
strings.…저기, 지금 길드여관으로 가려고 하는 거야?: ...Um, are you two going to the Guild Inn now?
We're hungry, so Narsha and I were going to the Guild Inn...
strings.같이 가실래요, 총장님?: Would you like to join us, President?
strings.이런 이야기 해서 미안한데, 지금 여기 오면 귀찮아지는 인간이 와서 말이: I'm sorry to say this, but someone has arrived who'll make things troublesome if you come here now...
Listen to me just this once. Please...
strings.(그 순간, 데이나의 어깨 위로 누군가의 손이 올라온다. ): (At that moment, someone's hand comes to rest on Dayna's shoulder.)
strings.데이나, 이럴 셈이야?: Dayna, is this how you're going to behave?
Huh? Oh! Adventurer, bow and show your respects!
strings.(나르샤가 %s의 옷을 붙잡고 함께 허리를 숙인다.): (Narsha grabs %s's clothes and bows with them.)
You need not do that in front of me. %s, please raise your head.
strings.(고개를 들자 파란색 눈동자가 보석처럼 빛나는 여성이 인자한 미소를 짓고: (Looking up, I see a woman with sapphire-bright blue eyes and a kindly smile.)
strings.(후광이 비치는 것처럼 아름다운 분…, 태양 형상의 티아라를 쓰고 계시네: (She's so beautiful it's as though she has a halo... She's wearing a sun-shaped tiara.)
strings.안녕하세요…. 그런데, 절 아시나요?: Hello... But do you know me?
strings.(여성이 갑자기 %s의 두 손을 덥썩 붙잡는다.): (The woman suddenly takes both of %s's hands.)
strings.만나뵙고 싶었는데, 그동안 기회가 없었네요. 저도 그렇고 %s 님도 바빴: I've wanted to meet you, but never had the chance. Both you and I have been busy, %s.
My foolish sister... Look what you've done...
strings.저는 카이나 던 실바리아…, 데이나의 언니 되는 사람이에요. 그동안 동생: I am Kaina Dawn Silvaria... Dayna's elder sister. Thank you for all the help you've given my younger siblings.
It's a pleasure to meet you too. But if you're Dayna's older sister...
strings.실바리아 제국 황제 폐하?!: Her Majesty, the Empress of the Silvaria Empire?!
